title: Infrastrukturarkitekt
description:
Vill du ta ansvar för den tekniska riktningen för ett av Försvarsmaktens största IT-  

system – en plattform som måste hålla när det verkligen gäller som mest?  

Vi söker en erfaren infrastrukturarkitekt till vår SAP-installation. Vi behöver din  

erfarenhet av att bygga och förvalta verksamhetskritiska miljöer, och din nyfikenhet  

på ett stort tekniskt ekosystem.


**Därför är rollen viktig**  

Plattformen har bäring på hela Försvarsmakten och har en viktig roll för hela  

Försvarsmaktens förmåga att skydda Sverige i fred, kris och krig. Det ställer krav  

som få andra organisationer har: tillgänglighet som inte får förhandlas bort, säkerhet  

som en del av designen samt en arkitektur som tål att förutsättningarna ändras  

snabbt.


Vi kan erbjuda dig att vara med och forma Försvarsmaktens systemutveckling inom  

SAP S4/HANA i en av Sveriges största SAP-implementationer (PRIO).  

Försvarsmaktens Telekommunikations- och informationssystemförband (FMTIS)  

söker en ny kollega till Systemförvaltningsenheten (SFE) i Enköping. Vårt  

huvudsakliga uppdrag är att säkerställa systemens funktionalitet och säkerhet, att  

informationen är riktig och tillgänglig för att på så sätt bidra till Försvarsmaktens  

operativa förmåga.


Som systemarkitekt är du en central teknisk rådgivare och en drivande kraft i  

utvecklingen av våra SAP-lösningar. Du arbetar nära utvecklingsteamen och andra  

arkitekter och omsätter Försvarsmaktens behov till robusta, skalbara och långsiktiga  

tekniska lösningar.


Försvarsmaktens SAP-lösning fortsätter sin resa inom S/4HANA, SAP Business  

Technology Platform samt Embedded Analytics. I arkitektrollen ansvarar du  

tillsammans med våra övriga arkitekter och lösningsspecialister för att system PRIO  

har en långsiktig hållbar design och arkitektur. Vi är flera arkitekter som samarbetar  

tvärfunktionellt inom organisationen. Du förväntas även delta i forum utanför  

Försvarsmakten för omvärldsbevakning.  

  

Du kommer bland annat att jobba med:  

* Arkitektur i en flerstegsmiljö med höga krav på tillgänglighet, säkerhet och


spårbarhet  

- Databas- och plattformsarkitektur  

* Livscykelhantering inklusive uppgraderingar, patchningar och teknisk


modernisering på plattformsnivå  

* Identitet och åtkomst: SSO, certifikat och åtkomstmodeller
* Integrationsarkitektur och exponering mot andra system
* Ta fram teknisk målarkitektur och lösningsförslag
* Bidra till arkitekturprinciper, tekniska riktlinjer och den långsiktiga utvecklingen


av SAP-landskapet.
Vi söker dig med djup teknisk kompetens, gärna med erfarenhet av komplexa IT-  

landskap och integrationer. Du har en stor förståelse för teknisk arkitektur och  

utvecklingsprinciper och är van vid att fatta beslut med både kortsiktiga och  

långsiktiga konsekvenser i åtanke.


**Kvalifikationer**  

 Akademisk examen eller motsvarande erfarenhet som Försvarsmakten  

bedömer som likvärdig  

 Flerårig erfarenhet som arkitekt eller senior specialist inom infrastruktur,  

plattform eller drift av verksamhetskritiska system  

 Arbetslivserfarenhet av strategiska frågor kopplat till omvärldsbevakning  

 God förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska


**Meriterande**  

 Erfarenhet av SAP HANA  

 Erfarenhet av molnlösningar (SAP Cloud Platform, Azure)  

 Erfarenhet av automatisering


**Personliga egenskaper**  

Som person är du analytisk, lösningsorienterad och nyfiken. Du är trygg i tekniska  

diskussioner men kan kommunicera med verksamheten på ett sätt som gör komplex  

teknik begriplig och användbar.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
### **Join Telavox as a Systems Engineer for Storage**


Are you a hands-on systems engineer who thrives in operational depth and wants to own the storage that the rest of engineering runs on? At Telavox, we run our own: our own Ceph clusters, on-prem Kubernetes, and a fleet of physical servers across six countries. We're providers of infrastructure, not consumers of cloud - a deliberate choice, and what our product and economics demand. Storage is where we're investing next.


Ceph specifically is not a requirement. If you've run distributed or enterprise storage in production - Ceph, ZFS, Gluster, Lustre, MinIO, a vendor array - the instincts are what we're after, and we'll teach you ours.

#### **About the job**


This is a hands-on operations role. You'd own how our storage runs day-to-day - health, capacity, upgrades, expansion, and the operational foundations underneath it. You'll have real input into architecture, and you'll set the long-term direction with our storage lead rather than on your own. The emphasis here is deliberately operational - if making storage actually work, and being trusted to do it unsupervised, is the part you want, there's a lot of room in this role.

**Ceph (block and S3)** is our main estate - real production storage, growing across regions, with Sweden the largest footprint.

**Your day-to-day would be mostly spent on things like:**

* Keeping the clusters healthy - issues, monitoring, capacity planning, upgrades, and expansion across regions
* Getting the foundations right: stability, security, predictable scaling.
* Making the work repeatable - runbooks, upgrade procedures that hold across regions, automation for what's manual today
* You won't work in isolation from the rest of the platform: on-prem Kubernetes runs most of our workloads and has clear impact on the storage domain, and our Ansible-driven server and OS fleet spans six countries

**How we work together:**


You’ll join our Infrastructure Engineering team of around 15 people, working from our Malmö HQ, Gjuteriet, with international colleagues working remotely. English is our working language, and Swedish is a bonus.


There’s no mandatory on-call rotation, although Compute and Storage have an informal secondary list. You’ll have real ownership from day one, with plenty of room to identify, propose, and implement improvements. We also use Claude Code across Engineering, and you’ll help explore how it can support our platform work.

#### **About you**


You treat automation as the direction and repetition as its trigger, you factor in risk from the start rather than discovering it at the end, and you're pragmatic enough to do the manual work until automation catches up.

**We're looking for:**

* **Real operational depth in distributed or enterprise storage** - a system you've run in production, been on the hook for, and debugged under pressure. Which system matters far less than how deeply
* **Strong Linux fundamentals** - the substrate everything else sits on
* Comfort taking an unclear problem, scoping it, and seeing it through


We strongly value experience with Ceph or object storage at scale, Ansible or similar configuration management, and operating systems across distributed environments. Experience with on-prem Kubernetes, server/OS lifecycle management, or firmware, BIOS, and BMC/IPMI is also a plus.


We’re looking for someone at a mid-to-senior level, with growth focused on deeper expertise, broader ownership, and becoming the go-to person for storage across the organisation.

#### **Join us at Telavox**


Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.  

  

Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.  

  

We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.


Read more about our new HQ in Malmö !

### **How to apply!**


At Telavox, we don't focus on fitting in; we focus on making room for everyone.  

  

We’re always on the lookout for great talent, so applications are reviewed continuously. If you're ready to be part of an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, apply today with your CV and cover letter in English.


For any questions, feel free to reach out to **Emil Nilsson, Engineering Manager** **emil.nilsson@telavox.com.**

 **Learn more about what we do! ️**

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
*We're at a pivotal moment for both Tibber and the planet. When joining Tibber, you won’t just help scale a forward-thinking tech company - you’ll contribute to a real shift in how people consume electricity. With millions of smart devices connected to the Tibber platform (like electric vehicles and smart thermostats), we have one of the most unique energy trading portfolios on the market.*

*We’re looking for a Senior Security Engineer to join us in making the energy transition happen - maybe that’s you?*

**Job Mission**

As a Senior Security Engineer, you'll play a key role in securing the platform that powers the energy transition for hundreds of thousands of homes. You'll be the technical backbone of our security posture - building controls, embedding security into how we build products, and making sure our engineers default to secure.

**What you'll do**

* **Secure the platform.** Own the security posture of our cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes platform - identity and access, network segmentation, secrets management, encryption, workload hardening, logging, alerting and detection. Build guardrails so secure is the default path for our engineers.
* **Embed security in how we build products.** Partner with product teams on threat modelling and secure design reviews. Run and tune code, dependency and container scanning through to remediation, and coordinate external penetration tests.
* **Turn compliance into engineering**. Implement the technical controls behind our ISO/IEC 27001, NIS2 and NIST CSF work, automate evidence collection, and translate requirements into backlog items engineers can act on.
* **Raise the bar on corporate IT security.** Strengthen the security configuration of our identity provider, endpoint management, SaaS integrations and office networks.
* **Own incident response for the technical estate.** Maintain and exercise runbooks, lead technical investigation and containment, and drive learnings back into the platform.
* **Make the whole company better at security.** Share knowledge, run workshops and champion a culture where security is everyone's concern and never a blocker for its own sake.

**What we're looking for**


You are driven by impact and know how to turn strategy into execution. You're used to fast-paced environments and thrive when given clear goals and high accountability. We believe you'll thrive here if you:

* Have hands-on security engineering experience in a modern, cloud-native software company - and have seen what scale and growth do to a security posture.
* Are deeply comfortable in at least one major cloud(preferably AWS) and with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines. You can read and write code and would rather automate a control than document a manual one.
* Know the practical security toolset - identity federation, secrets management, logging, vulnerability management and backup and recovery - and understand the trade-offs between options.
* Have translated frameworks like ISO 27001, NIS2 or SOC 2 into concrete technical controls and audit evidence, including running threat modelling with product teams.
* Are excited about how Tibber becomes more AI-enabled and embrace new tools and ways of working. You don't need to be an expert, but we believe you are motivated by that and excited to grow with it too.

**‍️‍️The Tibber Mindset**

*Tibber exists to drive energy independence - away from fossil dependency. Our tech helps hundreds of thousands of households shift their electricity consumption to more sustainable and affordable hours - from electric vehicles to smart thermostats, all connected to the Tibber platform. We strengthen the resilience of the grid. Not in theory. In everyday life.*

*We win, fail, and grow together, staying curious and pushing for better every day. AI is shaping how we work - and we're on a journey to make it central to everything we do. The further we go, the more our Tibberinos matter - and yes, that's what we call ourselves!*

*Started by two founders in 2016. Now 300+ Tibberinos across Stockholm, Oslo, Berlin, Amsterdam, and Førde. And we're still just getting started.*

*You're welcome at Tibber for who you are. We hire for what you can do and how you think - not your background or where you've been. Diverse teams build better products, and we mean that.*

title: Full-Stack Engineer, Platform & Integrations - HealthTech
description:
**Full-Stack Engineer, Platform & Integrations**
================================================


Velora Health, AI-native HealthTech · Stockholm, hybrid · Full-time


Stack: React and React Native · Hono on Bun · Drizzle and PostgreSQL · Google Cloud Platform · Stripe, Firebase, BankID, PostHog

**About Velora Health**
-----------------------


Velora Health is a rapidly growing AI HealthTech startup on a mission to address the leading causes of preventable death. Our goal is bold yet simple: a longer and healthier life for more people, through the fusion of personalized care and a holistic approach to health.


We started by tackling one of the biggest global health issues: obesity, which affects nearly 1 billion people worldwide. Through our platform and digital health clinic at velora.se we have already helped thousands of patients lose weight and keep it off, which means they live longer and with fewer diseases such as type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease. In Sweden alone, 2 million people could live longer with Velora. We are now expanding beyond obesity into broader chronic care, giving people access to the latest and most effective research-based treatments.


We are AI-native and use AI across the whole company. Today we are a 20-person team across clinical care, engineering, growth and operations. In engineering you will have five or six colleagues you work closely with every day across engineering, product and design, plus the clinicians who use what you build. We run two products on one TypeScript codebase, Velora Tools for our clinicians and the patient portal (web app plus two native apps), and we ship to production every week.

**About the role**
------------------


Velora is looking for a full-stack engineer to own the systems that have to be right: payments and subscriptions, identity, third-party integrations and the internal platform (Velora Tools) our care team runs on. You will own outcomes, not just tasks: when a Stripe webhook arrives out of order or BankID behaves unexpectedly, you are the person who understands the whole path and decides where the fix belongs.


The interesting work here is rarely an isolated endpoint. It is understanding the entire flow, choosing where logic lives, handling failure properly and keeping the platform easy to change as we grow.

**What you'll do**
------------------

*We build two products on one TypeScript codebase: Velora Tools, the system our clinicians run their day on, and the patient portal, a web app plus two native apps (iOS and Android). You will work across both, with Velora Tools and the shared platform as your home turf.*

* Build product, end-to-end: take a clinician or patient problem from investigation through the React UI, the Hono API and PostgreSQL to production, and follow it there.
* Think in systems and abstractions: see the platform behind the feature request, decide where the logic belongs and build the right primitive once for Velora Tools, the web app and both native apps.
* Evolve Velora Tools so clinicians and operations can work accurately and fast, from schemas to screens.
* Own the payments and subscriptions domain: Stripe flows, webhooks, retries, reconciliation and the data model behind them.
* Build and harden integrations with BankID, Firebase and external services, designing for partial failure and inconsistent responses.
* Add the logging, monitoring and error handling that make production understandable, and investigate incidents when they happen.
* Improve CI/CD, local development and testing on Google Cloud so the team ships faster with more confidence.

**You may be a good fit if you**
--------------------------------

* Have 3+ years of experience building and operating production backend or full-stack systems, ideally in TypeScript.
* Think in failure modes: idempotency, retries, ordering, timeouts and what the user sees when something breaks.
* Can operate as a team of one when needed, taking a problem from investigation to production, while bringing in the right people when a decision affects the wider product.
* Own outcomes, not just code. You care whether the payment was actually correct, not whether the ticket was closed.
* Prefer the smallest change that solves the problem and can tell when a new abstraction is warranted.
* Hold yourself to a high bar without needing external pressure.
* Use AI tools daily, stay up to date as models, tools and best practices evolve, and confidently question generated answers, verify assumptions and recognise when privacy, security or correctness require extra care.

**Strong candidates will have**
-------------------------------

* Built or owned payment, subscription or identity systems in production.
* Proficiency across the stack (TypeScript, React, a Node/Bun backend, PostgreSQL) with depth on the backend.
* Experience running services on GCP or a comparable cloud, including CI/CD, secrets and observability.
* Experience in healthcare, fintech or another regulated environment.
* A track record of shipping independently, not just contributing to larger efforts.

**Logistics**
-------------

**Location:** Hybrid, with our office in Stockholm. We like to see each other in person about once a week, but it is not a requirement; work from where you work best.

**Language:** Fluent Swedish, spoken and written, is required. Our clinicians, patients and internal tools are Swedish, and you will be talking to all three. Our codebase and documentation are in English.

**Compensation:** Monthly salary set by experience and scope.

**Start:** As soon as we find the right person.


We encourage you to apply even if you do not match every line above. We would rather talk to a strong engineer with an unusual background than miss them because of a checklist.

**How we are different**
------------------------


We are a healthcare company that behaves like a product company. Payments, identity and clinical workflows are all in one codebase, so a single engineer can own a problem from the patient's screen to the database and back. Mistakes matter here, which is why we ship small, review carefully and keep the bar high.


We use AI heavily in development: exploring the codebase, prototyping, writing tests, reviewing changes. You choose your own editor and tools and we pay for them. You are still responsible for what you ship, and in a healthcare context that means knowing when the tool is wrong.


You will work directly with our lead engineers, product lead and the founders. There are no layers between you and the people who decide what we build.


We are 20 people today and the engineering team will roughly double over the next year. The people who join now will be the ones who shape how we build, and several of them will lead teams, own domains or take on roles that do not exist yet. Your scope here is set by what you take on, not by your title.

**Hiring process**
------------------


1. **Intro call, 30 minutes.** Role, expectations, how we work.


2. **Technical interview, 60–90 minutes.** A realistic problem from our stack, live or take-home, your choice.


3. **Team conversation.** Meet the people you would work with. Collaboration, product thinking, working style.


4. **Final conversation with leadership.** Mutual fit and alignment.


5. **References and offer.** Most candidates complete the process within three weeks.

title: Marknadskommunikatör nyproduktion och förvaltning av hyresbostäder
description:
Vill du vara med och forma hur Klövern marknadsför och utvecklar sin växande hyresrättsaffär? Trivs du i en bred roll där du får kombinera strategi, kreativitet och eget genomförande? Nu söker Klövern en marknadskommunikatör som vill ta ett tydligt helhetsansvar för marknadsföringen av nyproducerade hyresbostäder och kommunikationen genom hela kundresan.

**Om tjänsten**


Det här är en ny roll som skapas när Klövern växlar upp arbetet med hyresbostäder i egen förvaltning. Du blir en del av kommunikations- och marknadsfunktionen och rapporterar till kommunikations- och marknadschefen. I nära samarbete med kollegor inom projektutveckling, förvaltning och försäljning får du ansvar för marknadsföring och kommunikation i Klöverns hyresrättsprojekt i olika skeden.  

  

Rollen sträcker sig från tidig plats- och konceptutveckling till uthyrning, inflyttning och löpande förvaltning. Du omsätter strategi till konkreta aktiviteter, skapar själv när det är rätt väg och leder byråer och andra partners när uppdraget kräver det. Det här passar dig som vill arbeta nära både kund och affär och som uppskattar ett sammanhang med korta beslutsvägar.

**Dina arbetsuppgifter**


I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

* Ansvara för marknadsföring och kommunikation i flera parallella hyresrättsprojekt, från tidig projektutveckling till uthyrning, inflyttning och förvaltning.
* Omsätta övergripande strategi till målgrupper, budskap, marknadsplaner och aktiviteter för respektive projekt.
* Utveckla kundresan och skapa aktiviteter som bygger intresse, genererar relevanta leads och bidrar till en effektiv uthyrning.
* Paketera projekt genom koncept, positionering, copy, bildval och grafisk tillämpning.
* Planera, skapa och publicera innehåll för Klöverns hyresrättsaffär i sociala medier och andra digitala kanaler samt utveckla innehåll för projektsidor, platskommunikation och material inför visningar och event.
* Planera och följa upp annonsering och medieköp samt kravställa och samarbeta med byråer och andra externa partners.
* Bidra till att utveckla arbetssätt och flöden mellan marknadsföring, CRM, uthyrning och förvaltning.
* Identifiera PR-möjligheter, ta fram utkast till pressmeddelanden och integrera hållbarhet i relevanta budskap och aktiviteter.
* Ansvara för projektens marknadsbudgetar och prioritera insatser utifrån affärsnytta och effekt.

**Är det här du?**


Vi söker dig som har minst fem års relevant erfarenhet av kvalificerat och brett marknadsarbete. Du är van att driva uppdrag från målgrupp, strategi och plan till produktion, lansering och uppföljning.


Du har en relevant eftergymnasial utbildning, eller motsvarande kvalifikationer genom relevant arbetslivserfarenhet. Erfarenhet från fastighetsbranschen, bostäder eller annan projektintensiv och kundnära verksamhet är meriterande.


Du har en stark digital förståelse och erfarenhet av målgruppsarbete, kundresor, leadgenerering och CRM.


Du skriver mycket bra på svenska och kan skapa tydlig copy för olika kanaler och målgrupper. Du har också ett gott visuellt öga och kan själv ta fram enklare material i exempelvis Adobe Creative Cloud eller Figma.


Erfarenhet av WordPress, HubSpot, HomeQ, PR eller hållbarhetskommunikation är ett plus.


Som person är du initiativtagande och bra på att bygga relationer. Du kombinerar kreativ höjd med ett tydligt genomförandefokus och kan prioritera mellan flera projekt med olika behov och tidplaner. Du är trygg i att sätta ramar, tydlig i samarbetet med beställare och leverantörer och prestigelös när det behövs.


Vi tror också att du är nyfiken, affärs- och kundorienterad och trivs i en miljö där du får vara med och utveckla både arbetssätt och erbjudande.


Rollen innebär resor till Klöverns projekt och ibland deltagande vid visningar och andra aktiviteter. Vi ser gärna att du kan visa exempel på tidigare arbeten senare i processen.

**Vill du veta mer?**


I denna rekrytering samarbetar Klövern med Level Recruitment.


Vänligen sök tjänsten genom att klicka på "ansök"-knappen här intill. Vid frågor vänligen kontakta rekryteringskonsult Jenny Heffler på 08-120 50 428.


Urvalet av ansökningar sker löpande. Välkommen in med din ansökan!

title: AI Architect
description:
**ABOUT ENGAGE STUDIOS**


We design, innovate and build digital / physical products for the world's largest - and Sweden's smallest company. Our guiding principle is to make a difference - for the better. Ideas are good and execution is the success factor. We are people and teams who are not afraid to question, roll up our sleeves and laugh all the way to the finish line.


Since the start in 2009, we have worked with basically all manufacturing / developing companies in Sweden. The Volvo companies, IKEA, H&M, Electrolux, Lynk&Co, Zeekr, Houdini to name a few. Our customers are in the traditional Swedish industry all the way to innovative startups in Silicon Valley. They are not found in oil drilling or the military industry. We are determined to make our presence and work known with passionate and dedicated employees who love design, tech and people.

**WE OFFER**


At Engage Studios, you will work in many different industries for different customers. You will work with incredibly smart and dedicated colleagues. Together we develop products and services that you can brag about to your friends. We at Engage Studios are always at the forefront of technology development. We develop and share knowledge with each other to get better tomorrow. With us, you get the opportunity to realize your dreams, big and small.


You will be based at our client on the west coast of Sweden. Our client is a European research and development organisation working on next-generation vehicle architectures, digital technologies, and intelligent systems. This is a longterm, full-time, on-site assignment.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**


Our client is looking for an AI Architect (EU AI Platform Engineer / Architect) to own the EU-side architecture, deployment, and adaptation of an agentic AI platform. You ensure that shared platform components can be securely, compliantly, and reliably deployed within the EU cloud and enterprise environment.

* Demonstrated success negotiating with and influencing executive leadership, significant customers, partners, analysts, or vendors to shape technical decisions and business outcomes.
* Ability to exercise wide latitude in determining objectives and approaches for complex, critical assignments with material regional, functional, or market impact.

title: Psykolog till behandlingsteam BUP- Tillsvidaretjänst på trevlig mottagning!
description:
Barn- och ungdomspsykiatrin (BUP) är en sektion i framkant. Här träffar vi barn och ungdomar upp till 18 år samt deras familjer. Vi arbetar utifrån evidensbaserade metoder och standardiserade vårdprocesser och lägger stor vikt vid högkvalitativ vård och vårdutveckling. Inom verksamheten bedrivs också mycket forskning.
  

  

Vi behöver nu utöka vårt team på mottagningen och söker därför en ny psykolog till vår behandlingsmottagning. På mottagningen arbetar psykologer, läkare, sjuksköterskor, skötare, arbetsterapeuter, dietister och kuratorer. För att säkerställa att patienterna får en god vård och behandling samarbetar vi i interprofessionella team. Vi bedriver ett målinriktat förbättringsarbete av vården och vi arbetar aktivt med att förbättra och utveckla personalens arbetsmiljö. Medarbetarna på mottagningen är öppna, positiva, kompetenta och ambitiösa, vilket gör det lätt att komma som nyanställd till mottagningen.
  

  

Ditt uppdrag
  

Vi söker nu en psykolog till behandlingsmottagning 2. Arbetet som psykolog innebär att du tillsammans med övriga i teamet arbetar med behandling av barn och ungdomar och deras familjer enskilt men vi har också en utbredd gruppverksamhet som du kan bli delaktig i. Kontinuerligt samarbete med föräldrar och vårdgrannar är en naturlig del av arbetet. I arbetet ingår även samarbete med BUPs övriga verksamheter, skola och socialtjänsten.
  

  

Att vara psykolog på Akademiska sjukhuset är ett spännande arbete där du får möta människor i många olika situationer. Du blir också en del av ett skickligt team som stöttar och hjälper varandra samtidigt som du kommer att arbeta självständigt. Här kan du räkna med ett varierande arbete med utmanade arbetsuppgifter.
  

  

Dina kvalifikationer
  

Du är en legitimerad psykolog. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med specialistpsykiatri, barn och unga och speciellt meriterande om du har arbetat med traumabehandling. Du tycker om arbete i interprofessionella team och vill bidra till att mottagningens arbete och rutiner utvecklas på ett positivt sätt.
  

  

Din kompetens
  

Du sätter alltid patienten i fokus och är ansvarstagande och motiverad i ditt arbete. Du är inte bara en skicklig psykolog, utan också en engagerad och positiv kollega som bidrar till en bra arbetsmiljö. Har du detta kombinerat med nyfikenhet och noggrannhet kan du vara rätt för oss.
  

  

Vi erbjuder
  

Vi erbjuder en tillsvidaretjänst med start så snart som möjligt. Som nyanställd hos oss får du en mentor. Vi finns i nyrenoverade lokaler mitt i Uppsala. Arbetet är förlagt till dagtid på vardagar. Du arbetar i team med härliga kollegor.
  

  

Inför tillsättning kommer, enligt rutin vid anställning, utdrag från misstanke- och belastningsregister att tas ut.
  

  

Hos oss får du förmåner som gör skillnad, läs om förmånerna här.
  

  

Vill du veta mer?
  

Psykolog David Roos,072-23 95 763
  

Avdelningschef Karin Cloud Mildton, 018-6173726
  

Facklig kontakt nås via växeln 018-611 00 00
  

  

Vill du jobba med oss?
  

Välkommen med din ansökan via länken nedan.Vi gör intervjuer löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - AI Cost Visibility
description:
**Location**

  


The senior Full-Stack Engineer will be an integral part of our Engineering teams in EMEA.This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.


**Who We Are**  

DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.  

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.  

With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.


**The Opportunity**  

AI is the fastest-growing line on our customers' cloud bills - and the hardest one to see. Model APIs, managed inference, GPUs, and a growing fleet of agentic coding tools each report spend differently, and most teams still can't answer the basic questions: what are we spending, on which workloads, for which teams, and is it worth it. Our AI cost visibility product, part of DoiT Cloud Intelligence, exists to answer them.  

We're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer into our R&D team to own this product end-to-end - from the Go services that ingest and model AI spend, through the APIs that expose it, to the React interfaces where FinOps practitioners and platform engineers make decisions. This is a young product in a category being defined right now. You'll shape how it works, not just implement someone else's spec, and there is a short line from your work to what customers see.  

You'll work AI-augmented from day one. We expect you to use AI across your whole workflow - not as an occasional autocomplete - and to have real opinions about where it earns its place and where it doesn't.


**Responsibilities**

* Owning features end-to-end. This is the core of the role. Take a problem from understanding the customer's pain, through design and implementation, to release, monitoring and iteration. You define what done looks like and you own the outcome - reliability, user experience and measurable impact included. Propose the work you think should happen; you're not here to wait for a spec.
* Knowing the product and the domain. Understand how AI spend actually works - token and model pricing, inference and GPU economics, how usage rolls up to teams and initiatives - and how FinOps practitioners reason about it. You should be able to explain why a feature matters to a customer as clearly as how it's built, and bring that judgement into every design decision.
* Working AI-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work - exploring the codebase and unfamiliar vendor APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar.
* Full-stack delivery. Design, build and scale backend services in Go and product experiences in TypeScript and React. Turn large volumes of cost and usage data into interfaces that make the answer obvious - clear, fast and trustworthy enough to base financial decisions on.
* API-first. Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform.


Raising the bar. As a senior engineer, set the standard for the team: thoughtful design reviews, guard-rails that let customers succeed, and engineering practices that let us move fast without breaking trust. Mentor peers and share what you learn.  

  

**Qualifications**


* 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including multi-tenant SaaS products, with a track record of owning features or products end-to-end in production
* Strong Go for backend services - APIs, data processing, and the operational realities of running them
* Strong TypeScript and modern React, with a good eye for how data should be presented
* Comfortable across the stack. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the data model through to the interface
* Experience building on public cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure), and working proficiency in SQL against an analytical store such as BigQuery
* Product-oriented thinking - you care as much about why you're building something and whether it works for users as you do about how it's built
* AI-augmented working style - you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them, and where they fell short
* Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles, and the ability to set direction for others
* Comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving market - you can figure out the right problem to solve, not just the right solution
* Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal


Self-organized, goal-oriented and self-motivated; confident, thorough and tenacious  

  

**Bonus Points**


* Knowledge of FinOps and FinOps products would be a strong plus.
* BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrating a portfolio of what you've built in your career so far


**Are you a Do'er?**  

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.  

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.  

What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.  

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.  

We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.

title: Customer Executive – Salesforce Sweden
description:
**Customer Executive – Salesforce Sweden**
------------------------------------------


Would you like to join the leading business technology company in the Nordics? Do you speak both business and technology fluently – and enjoy turning customer challenges into new business? If yes, keep reading.


Sofigate is growing, and we are looking for an ambitious and commercially driven **Customer Executive – Salesforce Sweden** to accelerate the growth of our Salesforce business in Sweden. You will take ownership of both developing strategic customer relationships and opening new ones, with a strong focus on creating opportunities and closing new business.


In this role, you will engage with senior business and technology leaders, identify transformation opportunities and bring together Sofigate’s Salesforce, AI and business transformation capabilities to create compelling solutions and measurable business value for our customers.


We expect you to have experience from the Salesforce ecosystem and a strong understanding of complex B2B technology or consulting sales.

**What we expect from you**

* ***Proven deal maker:*** You have a strong track record of winning new business and closing complex B2B technology or consulting deals. You enjoy prospecting, opening new doors and turning opportunities into revenue.
* ***Collaborative seller:*** You know how to bring the right experts, consultants and partners into the sales process and turn their expertise into a winning customer proposition.
* ***Business-driven customer engagement:*** You can engage senior business and technology leaders, understand their strategic priorities and translate them into compelling Salesforce transformation opportunities.
* ***Versatile background:*** Your diverse sales experience, combined with a background in growth-oriented companies, makes you adaptable and innovative.
* ***Executive relationship builder:*** You have a strong network in the Swedish market and the credibility to engage C-level decision-makers, build new relationships and create business opportunities.
* ***Senior sales professional:*** You bring extensive experience in complex B2B technology, consulting or transformation sales and know how to manage the full sales cycle from first contact to signed deal.
* ***Salesforce market understanding:*** You have experience selling Salesforce, CRM, cloud platforms or related transformation services and understand how technology, consulting services and partner ecosystems come together in complex customer solutions.
* You speak Swedish and also AI fluently. Agentforce and Data360 are not just techy talk as you can not only explain but also frame their value and some use cases to a customer. Leveraging AI and agents in your own work comes naturally.


We know our list of requirements is long but in the end we’re after the right mix. We’re looking for talent and potential. Dare and get in touch with us.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and grow a strong Salesforce sales pipeline in Sweden, with a clear focus on new business.
* Identify and open new strategic customer relationships and turn them into concrete sales opportunities.
* Own the sales cycle from prospecting and opportunity qualification to proposal, negotiation and closing.
* Grow selected existing accounts and identify new Salesforce transformation opportunities within them.
* Build trusted relationships with C-level business and technology decision-makers.
* Work closely with Salesforce, Sofigate consultants, solution experts and delivery teams to create winning propositions.
* Lead complex sales processes, including RFI/RFP processes, commercial negotiations and value propositions.
* Contribute market and customer insight to the development of Sofigate's Salesforce offering in Sweden.

**What’s in it for you?**


Want to work with world-class technologies, best-in-class business technology management practices and a team of experts? You’re in the right place with us.


As a Sofigator, you get the opportunity to work with knowledgeable and driven colleagues, develop and challenge yourself and create sustainable value for our customers. We have an international, vibrant and fun culture with great openness and flexibility. We value every Sofigator and strive to build a diverse, equal, and inclusive workplace where everyone’s voice is heard, and where everyone can become the best versions of themselves. We value a healthy work life balance and support you in maintaining it.


Growth is not just a corporate thing for us – it is personal. There is so much to explore and learn within our community, and together with our customers, that having a bit of fun is unavoidable.

**We would like to hear from you**


Tell us your story and let us know why you are the change maker we are looking for.


If you have any questions, please contact:  

Mikael Ekman, Country Manager Sweden, at mikael.ekman@sofigate.com

**About Sofigate**


We are The Business Technology Company with the fastest time-to-value in the gen AI era. We achieve that by combining our transformation expertise with low/no-code platforms and generative AI. That’s how we create sustainable customer value.


In practice, that means helping our customers develop the interplay between business and technology: to design, build, and implement transformations and business-friendly technology solutions.

title: Senior AI Engineer - Center of Excellence
description:
### **About this role**


Enterprise software is going through its biggest shift in decades. Applications are moving from deterministic workflows to intelligent, agentic systems that understand context, remember preferences, and act on behalf of users. This isn’t a future prediction — it’s happening now, and Columbus is building at the frontier of it.

**We’re hiring three senior engineers to form the core of our Group AI engineering team.** Together, you’ll design and build the next generation of AI-powered systems that will transform how thousands of people work — across the Nordics and beyond. You’ll work directly with the VP Group AI. No layers. No committees. You build, you ship, you learn.


This is not a consulting engagement or a proof-of-concept. It’s production engineering at enterprise scale, on the Microsoft platform, using the most advanced AI models available today.

### **What you will bring**


We are looking for someone who have/is

* Strong expertise in LLM application design, including prompt engineering, agent frameworks, and evaluation
* Good undetstanding of data as a foundation for AI driven Insights
* Experience building scalable, production-grade AI systems, with focus on context management, cost optimization, and real-world deployment
* Proven ability to design multi-agent architectures where AI systems collaborate effectively
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 ecosystem (Graph, Teams, SharePoint) and cloud-native platforms like Azure
* Solid background in data and retrieval systems, including vector search, embeddings, document databases, and RAG architectures
* Skilled in building robust, event-driven and API-based systems with strong focus on reliability, security, and enterprise compliance
  

If you don't match all these qualification above but is an expert in either of the three, don't hesitate to apply:  

  

**AI Application**  

You bring deep experience in LLM application architecture, including prompt engineering, agent frameworks, tool integration, and model evaluation. You have a strong understanding of context window management, cost optimisation, and model behaviour at scale, combined with expert knowledge of AI Security and AI Governance.

**AI Automation & Integration**  

You have hands-on experience with Microsoft Graph, Teams, SharePoint, and the broader Microsoft 365 ecosystem. In addition, you possess expert knowledge of AI Security and AI Governance as they relate to automation, integrations, and enterprise-scale AI solutions.

**AI Infrastructure**  

You bring extensive experience with document databases, vector search technologies, and embedding models. You understand RAG architectures, including chunking, reranking, hybrid search, and citation grounding, and can design data governance frameworks that meet enterprise compliance requirements such as DLP, auditing, and retention. You have experience building scalable knowledge retrieval systems, supported by expert knowledge of AI Security and AI Governance.

### **Application**


At our company, you can easily apply using your LinkedIn profile or your CV, without having to fill out long questionnaires. You do not need to submit a cover letter.


In our recruitment process, we use logic and personality tests. We always check references and conduct a background check before an employment offer is made. If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact the responsible recruiter Daniel Sparrow. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.


After the recruitment process has ended, we will ask you about your experience as a candidate. It only takes a few seconds to answer, and it helps us improve our recruitment process.

### **Working at Columbus**


People always come first at Columbus. We are a global consulting firm with local presence, helping companies with their digital transformation and to thrive through technology, data, and human insight. We are also a workplace where you, as an employee, can develop your career and get support through clear and structured career paths.  

  

Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, curiosity, and a shared commitment to deliver value to our clients. Whether you’re experienced or just starting out in your career, you’ll find the freedom to explore ideas, challenge the familiar, and shape your own path with us.  

  

With more than 1,500 colleagues in over 10 countries, we combine global perspectives with local understanding. What unites us is our belief in creating meaningful impact – for our employees, our clients, and the journey ahead.


Let’s thrive, grow, and shape the future together!


### **What others say about us**


Interested in Columbus behind the scenes? Each week, we let a colleague take over our Instagram account.


At Careereye, current and former employees can share their **unfiltered reviews about what it’s like to work with us**. Click below to read their experiences.

title: Solution Developer and Tech Lead, Google Cloud – Cloud Foundations | SEB, Solna
description:
Join Cloud Foundations and help build the cloud platform the rest of the bank develops on. We deliver landing zones, guardrails and platform capabilities in Google Cloud so SEB's developers can move fast without compromising on security or compliance.
   

  

 This is a senior developer role with tech lead responsibility for our GCP platform. Our Solution Architect owns the target architecture. You own how it gets built: you lead the development work that turns architecture into a platform in production, and you are the link between the two. When a design meets reality, you are the one who spots what does not hold and takes it back to the architect.
   

  

 You still write code every week. You have no line management responsibility, but you are the technical lead for GCP development in the team, and one of a pair with the architect for the platform.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Develop and maintain our landing zones and underlying platform capabilities in Google Cloud together with the team.
* Lead the realisation of the target architecture: break it down into buildable work, set the technical direction for how it is implemented and see it through to production.
* Work side by side with our Solution Architect for GCP: pressure-test designs against implementation reality and from a security perspective, feed back what you learn from building, and support the architecture work with hands-on input.
* Set the bar for code quality, CI/CD and automated testing, and make it easy for the team to do the right thing.
* Take the lead when the situation is unclear: break the problem down, propose a solution and make the call on how it gets built.
* Be the go-to person for GCP implementation in our department, including work that stretches across several teams.
* Drive lifecycle management of the platform and stay ahead of technical debt before it gets expensive.
* Advise architects and development teams across the bank on how to build well on the platform.
* Coach colleagues through code review, pair programming and mentoring, and take part in hiring new team members.


**Who You Are**
 You are a driven, proactive and collaborative engineer who takes ownership and enjoys solving complex problems. You share what you know, you are not satisfied with the first solution that happens to work, and you can move between an architecture discussion and a pull request in the same afternoon. Openness and transparency are your baseline in a team.
   

  

**Skills And Experience**
* Several years of hands-on development in Google Cloud, with a track record of solutions you have built, launched and maintained over time.
* Experience of leading development work without formal line management, in a team or across several teams.
* A habit of working closely with architects and turning a target architecture into something that runs in production.
* Infrastructure as Code, automation and CI/CD in tools such as Terraform and GitHub Actions.
* Scripting and development in Python.
* Solid understanding of identity and access management, observability , networking and security in the cloud.
* Practical experience of agile ways of working, and of suggesting improvements that actually get implemented.
* University degree or equivalent experience.
* Fluent English, spoken and written.


**Nice to have**
* Experience of driving larger technical shifts across several teams or domains.
* Financial services or another regulated industry.
* Google Cloud certifications such as Professional Cloud Architect or similar.
* Public speaking and knowledge sharing outside your own organization.


**What We Offer**
* A technical team of around fifteen people where you have real influence over the platform.
* A platform used by development teams across the whole bank, with a long life expectancy on what we deliver.
* A clear technical lead role, with an architect next to you rather than above you.
* Room to broaden into our other cloud platforms, Azure and AWS, further down the road if you want to.
* A hybrid workplace with a balance between office and home.
* SEB staff banking and our wider benefits package.
* An office next door to Mall of Scandinavia in Solna.


**Do you want to be part of SEB?**
 It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.
   

  

 We encourage you to submit your application no later than 16th of September via the link in this advertisement. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Mikaela Ahlstrand at mikaela.ahlstrand@seb.se. Kindly note that we do not accept applications via email.
   

  

 Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.
   

  

 SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, which means that this position might be covered by internal redeployment.
   

  

 Learn more about working at SEB on our Career website or through our Career podcasts.
   

  

 sebgroup.com/career

title: Solutions Architect
description:

**Solutions Architect – Data & AI (Presales)**
 At Databricks, our Solutions Architects combine customer engagement with hands-on technical expertise.
   

  

 You will work closely with customers to understand their challenges and demonstrate how the Databricks platform can solve them – not just conceptually, but in practice.
   

  

 This role sits within our sales organization and is ideal for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of business, data, and AI — and who is motivated by turning ideas into working solutions.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Partner with Account Executives to drive technical sales cycles and customer outcomes
* Lead customer workshops, discovery sessions, and technical deep-dives across multiple stakeholders
* Build and deliver proof-of-concepts, demos, and solution prototypes using real data
* Translate business requirements into practical, scalable data and AI solutions
* Act as a trusted advisor, while also being able to go hands-on to validate solutions end-to-end
* Work through technical challenges with customers, iterating and resolving issues as they arise
* Contribute reusable assets, patterns, and best practices that accelerate adoption across customers


**What We’re Looking For**
**Customer-facing mindset**
* Experience working with customers in a presales, consulting, or advisory capacity
* Ability to communicate complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Comfortable leading discussions that connect business goals to technical decisions


**Hands-on technical foundation**
* Experience with Python (or similar) and familiarity with distributed data processing and compute and working with large-scale datasets
* Understanding of data pipelines and modern data architectures
* Ability to work practically with data (e.g. building PoCs, exploring datasets, troubleshooting)

* Familiarity with analytics, data science, or machine learning workflows

**Architecture & platform understanding**
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and data technologies
* Ability to design solutions that consider scalability, performance, reliability, and data volumes

**What Makes You Successful In This Role**
* You are comfortable switching between business dialogue and technical execution
* You don’t just describe solutions — you can build, validate, and iterate on them in practice
* You take ownership of technical challenges and push problems forward, even when things are not working as expected
* You apply structured thinking in discovery and can connect requirements to scalable technical solutions

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
**About The Company**
 A specialist in identity, secure transactions, and digital services, IN Groupe is the global leader in secure identity and trust services. Every day, our 4,000 employees across 40 countries work to ensure that everyone has access to a reliable and secure identity, both in the physical and digital worlds. With our solutions and our international network of 10 R&D centers, we support governments and businesses in more than 130 countries.
   

  

 Joining IN Groupe means helping to shape the future of the identity and secure transaction market. Become part of our international teams — driven by innovation and proud to design solutions that make life easier and protect personal data for millions of people around the world.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior backend engineer to join our Stockholm office** 
 with strong,
 **hands‑on expertise in modern Java,** 
 experienced in building and maintaining distributed systems and microservices. Brings solid proficiency in CI/CD and
 **Azure DevOps** 
 (or comparable platforms), along with practical knowledge of cloud environments, containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, automated testing practices, and operating services reliably in production.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Focus on backend development, with responsibility for services, databases, and system integrations.
* Develop, improve, and maintain services with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
* Select and use technologies based on problem-solving value, not trendiness.
* Ensure that deliveries are on time and secure, always balancing speed with quality.
* Collaborate closely with teammates and stakeholders, enabling fast and sustainable delivery.
* Over time, take a leading role in driving improvements in both technology and ways of working.


**Our Tech Stack (key areas for this role)**
* Java (primary language: deep expertise required)
* Spring Boot
* REST, Microservices, Databases
* Azure (cloud environment), Docker, Kubernetes


**About You**
* Highly experienced in backend Java development and proficient with Azure.
* Results-oriented: you deliver what is needed, when it is needed.
* Pragmatic: you enjoy new technology but choose what best solves the current problem while limiting technical debt.
* Humble and grounded: you listen, collaborate, and keep the team's health in mind.
* Independent yet collaborative: you take initiative but thrive in teamwork.
* User-focused: the end user's experience is always your guiding star.


**Qualifications**
* Extensive experience in Java backend development (main requirement).
* Experience with Spring Boot and modern development practices.
* Solid understanding of Microservices and integrations.
* Professional proficiency in English.


**What We Offer**
* Impactful work: Your code directly powers secure identity services used by real customers worldwide.
* A pragmatic environment: We value smart choices over shiny tools. You'll use the most adapted technologies to solve problems, reduce complexity, and limit future technical debt.
* A healthy team culture: We believe in humility, collaboration, and keeping team well-being in balance with delivery goals.
* End-to-end responsibility: You'll see the whole lifecycle, from development through deployment to customer use.
* Growth into leadership: Over time, you'll have the opportunity to take on a bigger role in driving initiatives and supporting others in the team.

title: Revops Specialist (Salesforce and Marketing Operations)
description:
📍
 **Stockholm (Hybrid / Flexible)**
**About B2b At Precis🏢**
 Precis is a digital marketing agency built on transparency, data, and a deep understanding of how to drive growth for our customers. B2B is one of the fastest growing business areas where we have the privilege of working with a portfolio of ambitious, large b2b brands across Europe. Our 50+ team consists of passionate individuals and caring team members who thrive on delivering great business value to our clients through innovation, taking responsibility, and collaborating in a highly dynamic and cross functional unit where there’s a lot of freedom and opportunity to influence where we go next and how.
   

  

**THE ROLE📜**
 CRM and Revenue Optimisation are the bedrock for sustainable growth for any b2b company, yet most companies fall short of delivering on the desired level of alignment that can propel the business forward. If you are the right candidate for the job, you’ll already have experienced this first hand and actively helped create synergies across Sales, Marketing and Service.
   

  

 As a team, we support clients with varied tech stacks: We see a mix of Salesforce Marketing and Sales Cloud, HubSpot Marketing and Salesforce Sales Cloud as well as a host of other tools.
   

  

 As a RevOps Specialist (L3), you will be acting as our Salesforce expert, helping us to shape our growing CRM offering. You will work as a sparring partner and a hands-on technical expert for our clients. This role blends your deep Salesforce platform expertise with your understanding of how Marketing, Sales and Services teams operate and what they need to work together. You are combining tangible marketing automation and marketing operations solutions with strategic insight, allowing you to connect the dots between client operational efficiency and tangible revenue results. Your stakeholders are Marketing leaders who need to drive operational efficiency to prove the value of their investments.
   

  

 Precis was founded in Stockholm, and Sweden is where many of our most ambitious collaborations are situated. While our internal language is English and we serve a portfolio of international clients, fluency in Swedish is a big plus for this particular role.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing 💼**
* Client Consulting: Work with key clients to understand and diagnose pain points in order to deliver technical and process improvements ensuring improved ROI on Marketing activities.
* Campaign execution: Design and build automated journeys, emails, set up segmentation or build multi-channel workflows using the client’s existing solutions.
* Platform Optimisation: Audit existing setups and make recommendations on how to improve lead management, nurture flows, reporting or automation setups based on the client’s overall goals.
* Business Process Automation: Support with the creation of end-to-end sales, marketing, and service automation to ensure successful lead handover.
* Integrations: Ensure key integrations are set up optimally.
* Data & Reporting Excellence: Partner with our Media and Analytics team to ensure data integrity, build reporting frameworks, and support clients in improving data quality. Built reports and dashboards in Salesforce.
* Internal and external enablement: Educate our clients around the solutions we build for them. Act as an internal subject matter expert, training wider client teams to understand CRM opportunities.


**What We Are Looking For ✔️**
* A team player. We are on a mission to build a world class B2B agency and team within Precis, and other than craft, we’re looking for kindness, ambition, and empathy.
* A minimum of 4 years domain experience working with Marketing teams and aligning with Sales and Customer Success teams.
* Deep Platform Expertise: Strong hands-on, configuration, and integration experience with Salesforce, Marketing is priority, Sales is a huge plus. Even better if you can also navigate HubSpot.
* Growth Mindset: An entrepreneurial spirit who is excited by ambiguity and eager to actively participate in building out processes for an expanding service line.
* The Strategic Doer: You love jumping between high-level business processes and diving deep into platforms to problem-solve and configure workflows yourself
* Revenue/Marketing Operations Background: A proven track record in Marketing and Sales Operations with a clear understanding of how to drive efficiencies through technical solutions when working with Marketing leaders.
* Client-Centric Consultant: Strong communication skills with a demonstrated ability to gather requirements in a complex environment and the ability to translate between process needs and technical requirements.
* Fluency in English and Swedish.


**What We Offer🌟**
*You can read our full offering in our* 
*handbook* 
*.*
* We offer a dynamic, curiosity-driven culture where innovation is at the forefront. You’ll work with some of the industry’s best in digital marketing and martech, all driven to explore new frontiers in a supportive, collaborative environment.
* An intense learning environment where you will be able to grow and develop your skills and passions alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry.
* Transparent salary setting, you can find all our salary bands in our Handbook - this role is an L2 or L3 role (depending on the final candidate's background) within the Media column. Check it out!
* 30 days paid leave, flexible public holidays, parental pay, a solid pension scheme and key insurances. Or different offices also offer different perks such as massage, health care contributions, free book orders, healthy snacks & great coffee, EAP programs and your choice of PC or Mac.
* A diverse environment with a high focus on inclusion and belonging. We speak over 27 native languages around Precis and our internal inclusion score is 4.3 out of 5.


*We are committed to building an inclusive and fair workplace that attracts talent and advances its people, regardless of their background, experiences or perspectives. We believe that a diverse set of minds will continue to contribute to our innovative culture and our ability to reinvent ourselves constantly.*
 🇬🇧 To make things as smooth as possible, please ensure your CV is in English.
   

  

**We update all candidates on their applications by email. If you don't receive an email from us, please check your spam folder.**
