title: Backend developer
description:
**About Froda**
 Froda was founded in 2015 with a clear vision – to revolutionize the banking experience for entrepreneurs by making it easy and affordable to invest in their ideas. Today, we are one of Sweden's fastest-growing fintech companies with large international growth plans. We are a creative tech company with the ambition to turn a historically expensive and unfair industry into something ethical and sustainable by promoting entrepreneurship.
   

  

 Our mission to revolutionize the banking experience for entrepreneurs is not only reflected in our products but also in our workplace. By fostering a culture of respect, collaboration, and continuous learning, we provide opportunities for personal growth and professional development. Join us in transforming the banking industry and be a part of our journey to empower entrepreneurs.
   

  

**About The Role**
 To further develop and scale our tech platform, enabling us to continue improving the banking experience for entrepreneurs, we are expanding our tech department. As a Backend Developer at Froda, you will be part of a cross-functional team working in one of our product areas — either developing features for our partners, improving our credit systems or maintaining our loan and payments core. For each team, the idea is to continuously deliver customer value as well as to improve the technical structure to make sure our systems are stable and healthy. Together with your team, you will design, build, and deliver scalable and maintainable solutions that directly impact our customers.
   

  

 You will get a unique chance to be a part of a scaling fintech company with strong momentum and a stable foundation, backed by a banking license as a quality stamp.
   

  

**Who are you?**
 We believe that you are an experienced and curious developer who thrives in collaborative environments and is passionate about building scalable solutions with real impact. You enjoy working closely with other skilled and open-minded professionals and actively contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. You are a pragmatic problem solver who communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are fluent in English, Swedish is a plus.
   

  

 We believe that you have experience of:
   

  

* At least 4 years in a similar role, ideally within product-focused teams
* Programming in C#/.NET with a solid understanding of modern software design principles
* Working with SQL and NoSQL databases in production environments
* Cloud platforms such as Azure (or other major providers)
* Agile methodologies and best practices in software engineering, including testing, CI/CD, and DevOps mindset
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ, and microservices architecture is a strong plus


**What’s in it for you?**
 At Froda, you’ll be part of a company that combines the best of both worlds – a fast-moving, high-energy culture with the stability and structure to support long-term success. We’re 100+ ambitious self-starters who genuinely care for each other and the work we do, all while having fun together.
   

  

 Here, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, develop your skills, and shape your own growth journey. With big ambitions and a rapidly evolving business, there’s plenty of room to grow, lead initiatives, and make a real impact on both our company and the industry. If you're looking to be part of a success story and contribute to something bigger, this is the place for you.
   

  

 Furthermore, you’ll get:
   

  

* An opportunity to be part of an exciting journey, shaping the future of our company and transforming the SME financing landscape
* Fabulous office overlooking Stockholm and a friendly culture that values work/life balance
* We prioritize working in the office to maximize the positive impact of in-person collaboration, but we offer flexibility with work hours and remote work
* Competitive compensation package
* Insurance and pension plan


 This role is all about building the tech that powers funding for thousands of entrepreneurs —if you're excited by our mission, apply or tell a friend!

title: Territory Systems Engineer, Commercial, (Nordics)
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
   

  

 This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
   

  

 As a Territory Systems Engineer, you will be the trusted technical partner to the Territory Account Executive and our valued Channel Partners. Your role is critical in translating Pure’s vision and innovative solutions into tangible, value-driven technical proposals for a broad and dynamic set of customers. You will play a pivotal part in accelerating growth by ensuring our partners and customers have the technical resources, validation, and support needed to successfully adopt Pure Storage solutions.
   

  

 At Pure, you'll join a culture built on curiosity, innovation, and integrity. We celebrate diverse perspectives, challenge convention, and empower our people to think big, take bold action, and make a measurable impact. This is your opportunity to grow your technical and sales career with one of the most innovative technology companies in the world and do work that truly changes how businesses use data to compete and win.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Territory Systems Engineer is a core technical role responsible for driving sales and technical adoption across our key commercial accounts in the Nordics. This position is for an experienced engineer who brings technical proficiency and a consultative approach to pre-sales. You will act as the technical authority within your territory, empowering partners to scale and delivering complex technical solutions with independence. You’ll be the bridge between customer business challenges and Pure’s technical vision, driving high-impact sales outcomes without the need for day-to-day oversight. This position requires a blend of technical acumen, partnership enablement, and a proactive approach to supporting high-volume, transactional sales motions. You will partner closely with the Territory Account Executive to lead technical sales campaigns, driving new business and expansion opportunities from discovery to closure. This Territory Systems Engineer role is a strategic position where you will immediately leverage your existing technical expertise and channel knowledge to drive high-volume, transactional sales motions.
   

  

 You won't be in this alone. You'll be joining a highly collaborative Nordics Systems Engineering team known for sharing knowledge and celebrating successes together. Your contributions will be immediately recognized and valued. We believe business happens between people, so you will act as a trusted advisor, leading high-stakes customer meetings across the Nordic region.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like: You will succeed by becoming the go-to technical partner in your territory. Success is defined by your ability to collaboratively drive deals to closure and your reputation as the advisor customers trust to solve their toughest infrastructure challenges.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Serve as the Technical Sales Lead: Partner directly with the Territory Account Executive to drive technical sales campaigns, manage complex discovery, present solutions, and secure deal wins.
* Drive Partner Collaboration and Enablement: While you will enable partner Systems Engineers to scale, you will also work side-by-side with them and the Territory Account Executive to execute on joint business opportunities and win competitive deals.
* Lead with Presence: You will manage technical relationships face-to-face across the Nordic region. This role involves travel (typically 2–3 days/week), which you and your Territory Account Executive will collaboratively schedule to maximize impact, meet customer needs, and win deals.
* Facilitate Technical Validation: Review and validate sizing, quotes, and technical architectures for various solutions, ensuring accuracy and alignment with customer needs and product capabilities.
* Drive Tool & Resource Adoption: Increase awareness and usage of Pure's sales and technical tools across the partner ecosystem, ensuring they are leveraged effectively at the appropriate stages of the sales cycle.
* Support Collaborative Growth: Build and maintain strong, productive relationships with both the Territory Account Executive and Channel Partners to ensure seamless technical support, shared goal achievement, and ultimately, closed deals.


**What You'll Bring**
* Proven Technical Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of professional experience in a customer-facing or pre-sales technical role (e.g., Systems Engineer, Solutions Architect, Infrastructure Consultant) within the IT infrastructure market. A track record of independently managing technical sales cycles and solving complex customer requirements is essential.
* Domain Expertise: Significant expertise (5+ years) with data storage, virtualization, or modern cloud infrastructure. You should possess the ability to troubleshoot complex issues and design solutions that go beyond standard configurations.
* Relationship-First Approach: Comfortable leading customer meetings and building deep, long-term technical relationships in person. You are eager to be on the road to ensure we maintain high-touch engagement across our territory.
* Collaborative Mindset: Demonstrated success working closely with a sales counterpart (like a Territory Account Executive) and channel partners to achieve shared business and technical objectives.
* Autonomy and Deal Ownership: A high degree of self-motivation and initiative with a proven ability to independently manage technical sales cycles, apply complex technical concepts effectively, and drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong Communication & Coaching Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate technical value to diverse audiences, from partner Systems Engineers to business decision-makers. Fluency in both Swedish and English is required.
* Organizational Resilience: Excellent organizational and time management skills necessary to juggle multiple partner engagements, technical validations, and training support activities in a dynamic territory.


**What You Can Expect From Us**
* Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
* Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.


 And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out purebenefits.com for more information.
   

  

**Accommodations And Accessibility**
 Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
   

  

**Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team**
 We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.
   

  

 Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.
   

  

**Join us and bring your best.**
**Bring your bold.**
**Pure and simple.**

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**
 At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
   

  

 Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.
   

  

**Senior Account Executive, Enterprise New Business — Sweden**
**Are You the Right Fit?**
* A proven hunter in Enterprise software sales?
* Motivated by opening new logos and building new territories from the ground up?
* Passionate about Cloud, SaaS, and AI-driven CX solutions?
* Resilient, proactive, and driven by ambitious targets?
* Comfortable leading competitive, high-velocity sales cycles?


 If so, we want to hear from you.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 This is a build-it role to own new business acquisition across the Swedish enterprise market and put Genesys Cloud on the map in accounts that have never bought from us before. Every logo you land expands our footprint and directly fuels the region's growth story. You'll introduce AI-powered experience orchestration to organisations ready to transform how they engage customers — and you'll own the full new business lifecycle end to end: shaping territory strategy, building pipeline from zero, and closing complex, high-value deals with senior stakeholders. At Genesys, you'll help deliver more human, connected customer experiences at scale, working alongside teams that prioritise collaboration, innovation, and meaningful impact. This role carries strong visibility across leadership, with real room to shape enterprise sales strategy and execution as you grow.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end-to-end acquisition of new enterprise customers across the Swedish market, driving consistent revenue growth
* Build and execute territory strategies that prioritise high-value accounts and scalable pipeline development
* Generate qualified pipeline through proactive prospecting, partner engagement, and strategic networking
* Lead complex, consultative sales cycles that position Genesys Cloud as a mission-critical platform
* Engage senior executives and business leaders to align solutions with strategic transformation goals
* Develop and execute competitive win strategies that increase deal success rates in enterprise environments
* Partner cross-functionally with business development, presales, marketing, and partners to accelerate deal progression
* Achieve and exceed new business quota through disciplined pipeline management and forecasting accuracy


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, or a related field
* 5+ years of enterprise software sales experience focused on new business acquisition within SaaS, AI, CCaaS, or cloud platforms
* Demonstrated success acquiring new enterprise customers within the Swedish market
* Strong experience in pipeline generation through prospecting and strategic account development
* Proven ability to manage complex, competitive sales cycles with multiple stakeholders
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and executive engagement skills
* Fluency in Swedish and English
* Willingness to travel frequently within Sweden and across the region as required


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience selling customer experience or contact center platforms
* Familiarity with AI-driven solutions and cloud-based architectures
* Experience collaborating within partner ecosystems to drive joint sales outcomes
* Strong understanding of enterprise digital transformation initiatives


**Working at Genesys**
* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
* Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
* Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
* Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys


 Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.
   

  

**What Happens After You Apply**
 After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:
   

  

* Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team
* A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview.
* Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team
* We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases
* After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps


 Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.
   

  

**Stay Connected**
 Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available.

**Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.**

**About Genesys:**
 Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. Genesys Cloud™ is the Agentic Orchestration Platform that securely connects people, systems, data and AI across the enterprise with built-in governance and control. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. title: Vice President, Sales - Northern Europe
description:
As Vice President of Sales, you will own the sales strategy, operating plan and commercial performance for the assigned geography, market or business unit. You will lead a large, complex sales organization through General Managers, country leaders, sales directors and functional leaders, with accountability for revenue, ARR, billing, pipeline, forecast accuracy, customer growth and market share.
   

  

 This role requires equal strength in strategic leadership and operational execution. You will run the day-to-day sales business with rigor while building the capabilities, routes to market, leadership bench and pipeline required to deliver growth over the next six to eighteen months. You will translate company strategy into differentiated market, segment and channel plans, allocate resources to the highest-return opportunities, and create a predictable operating cadence across the assigned scope.
   

  

 Every member of our A-Team has an instrumental role and impact on the success of Acronis' innovative and growing business. We are looking for a senior sales leader who thrives in a fast-paced, global environment and embodies our company values: responsive, alert, detail-oriented, makes decisions, and never gives up.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Sales strategy and growth**
* Own and execute the sales strategy, annual operating plan and rolling 12-18 month growth roadmap for the assigned scope, aligned with company priorities.
* Translate business objectives into clear market, segment and channel plans, including priorities, coverage, target allocation, headcount, investment and expected return.
* Balance current-quarter execution with medium-term growth by identifying whitespace, new customer segments, emerging use cases and scalable routes to market.


**Sales strategy and growth (continued)**
* Maintain a deep understanding of the cybersecurity, data protection and MSP landscape across the assigned markets, including competitors, regulation, customer needs, partners, distributors and technology alliances.
* Identify underperforming markets and growth constraints early, establish corrective action plans, and make timely decisions on leadership, coverage and resource deployment.


**Revenue, pipeline and forecast leadership**
* Own and exceed revenue, ARR, billing, retention and profitability objectives in line with the approved business plan.
* Establish a rigorous weekly, monthly and quarterly operating cadence covering forecast, pipeline creation, pipeline coverage, conversion, sales velocity, renewals, deal risk and execution against plan.
* Deliver accurate, evidence-based forecasts and ensure consistent CRM discipline, stage criteria, opportunity inspection and accountability across every market, business area and sales motion.
* Review performance at market, segment, channel and individual-team level; intervene decisively where results, pipeline quality or productivity fall below expectations.
* Act as executive sponsor for the most strategic opportunities and customers, helping teams shape value propositions, navigate complex buying groups, negotiate commercial terms and close high-impact deals.
* Protect future growth while delivering the quarter by maintaining sufficient pipeline coverage and ensuring systematic prospecting, partner activation, cross-sell, upsell and renewal execution.


**Leadership and organization**
**Leadership scope**
* Lead, align and hold accountable General Managers, country leaders, sales directors and assigned functional teams across the sales organization.
* Create a high-performance culture built on clear goals, transparent metrics, strong coaching, fast decision-making and disciplined follow-through.
* Build organizational capability through workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, leadership development, succession planning and proactive performance management.
* Develop strong second-line leaders who can independently run their markets or business areas while operating as one leadership team.
* Optimize organizational design, spans of control, territories, quotas and capacity to improve productivity and support sustainable scale.
* Lead through change and complexity, bringing together different markets, teams, cultures and sales motions around a common sales strategy and operating model.


**Go-to-market and ecosystem**
* Drive consistent execution of the Acronis Sales Model across direct, partner-led, service-provider, distribution and strategic-alliance motions.
* Define the partner and distribution strategy, including partner segmentation, recruitment, enablement, activation and joint business planning.
* Build executive relationships with leading MSPs, MSSPs, distributors, cloud and technology partners to accelerate customer acquisition, consumption and market coverage.
* Ensure effective alignment between enterprise, commercial, service-provider, renewal and channel teams, with clear ownership and minimal internal friction.
* Use marketing investment deliberately, partnering with marketing leaders on demand generation, market development, account-based programs and measurable pipeline contribution.


**Customer, market and cross-functional leadership**
* Build and maintain senior executive relationships with strategic customers, prospects and partners; serve as a senior point of escalation when required.
* Represent the voice of the assigned markets internally, providing actionable insight to Product, Marketing and executive leadership on customer requirements, competitive threats and growth opportunities.
* Partner closely with Solutions Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Finance, Product and Legal to improve win rates, adoption, retention and customer lifetime value.
* Represent Acronis as a senior market-facing leader at customer meetings, partner events, industry forums and executive engagements.
* Operate effectively within a global matrix, influencing stakeholders and securing the support required to deliver the sales plan.


**KEY DELIVERABLES**
* A clear sales strategy, annual operating plan and rolling 12-18 month growth roadmap for the assigned scope.
* Integrated market, segment and channel plans with agreed revenue targets, pipeline creation goals, resource plans and investment priorities.
* A reliable forecast and inspection cadence with transparent risks, corrective actions and executive-level reporting.
* An organization and succession plan covering capacity, critical hires, leadership development and performance gaps.
* Marketing, partner, distribution and strategic-account plans with measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes.
* Sustained improvement in sales productivity, market share, customer retention and profitable ARR growth.


**What You Bring**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Technology or a related field; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.
* Relevant cybersecurity or cloud industry education is an advantage. Executive-level commercial and market fluency is more important than a technical certification.


**Experience**
* 12+ years of progressive B2B technology sales and business development experience, including at least 8 years in senior sales leadership and significant second-line leadership responsibility.
* Proven success leading a large, complex, multi-market or multi-country sales organization through General Managers, country leaders, sales directors or equivalent second-line leaders.
* Deep experience in cybersecurity, cyber resilience, data protection, cloud, SaaS or another recurring-revenue technology business.
* Strong record of delivering sustained ARR and revenue growth, improving forecast accuracy, scaling pipeline generation and increasing sales productivity across a significant business scope.
* Demonstrated ownership of enterprise, commercial and partner-led sales motions, including MSPs, MSSPs, distributors, resellers and strategic alliances.
* Experience managing annual plans, budgets, headcount and resource allocation, with the commercial judgment to shift investment based on performance and market opportunity.
* Track record of building leadership teams, managing performance, developing successors and leading organizations through transformation or rapid growth.


**Experience (continued)**
* Established executive credibility with senior customers, partners and industry stakeholders in relevant markets.


**Leadership competencies**
* Strategic range: able to anticipate market shifts, set a clear direction and convert strategy into executable market-, segment- and channel-level plans.


**Leadership competencies (continued)**
* Operational rigor: highly effective in forecasting, pipeline inspection, performance management and disciplined execution.
* Commercial acumen: strong command of recurring-revenue economics, pricing, margins, renewals, partner models and complex deal structures.
* Cybersecurity market fluency: credible with customers and partners and able to connect business risk, technical value and commercial outcomes.
* Leadership at scale: inspires and develops senior leaders, creates accountability and builds a unified culture across countries and functions.
* Data-driven judgment: uses CRM, analytics and market evidence to identify trends, challenge assumptions and make timely decisions.
* Executive influence: communicates clearly with boards and executives, navigates a global matrix and influences without relying on formal authority.
* Resilience and agility: stays composed under pressure, moves quickly when conditions change and maintains focus through ambiguity.


**Additional Requirements**
* Fluent English; additional language requirements may apply depending on the assigned geography or business scope.
* Willingness and ability to travel frequently across assigned markets and internationally.


**Who We Are**
 Acronis is a global leader in cyber protection, delivering AI-powered protection for productive MSPs in a single, natively integrated platform that unifies operations management, cybersecurity, and data protection. Driven by our mission to protect, manage and automate every workload that businesses and lives depend on, we’ve built the industry’s only all-in-one solution.
   

  

 A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and employees in 50+ countries. Acronis Cyber Protect is available in 26 languages in 150 countries and is used by over 21,000 service providers to protect more than 750,000 businesses.
   

  

 Our corporate culture centers on innovation, accountability, and impact. We encourage our people to think boldly, challenge conventional approaches, and take ownership of outcomes. As a member of our global “A-Team,” you’ll operate in a high-growth, fast-paced environment where resilience, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement drive success.
   

  

*Acronis is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, medical condition, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.*

title: Customer Executive – Salesforce Sweden
description:
Would you like to join the leading business technology company in the Nordics? Do you speak both business and technology fluently – and enjoy turning customer challenges into new business? If yes, keep reading.
   

  

 Sofigate is growing, and we are looking for an ambitious and commercially driven
 **Customer Executive – Salesforce Sweden** 
 to accelerate the growth of our Salesforce business in Sweden. You will take ownership of both developing strategic customer relationships and opening new ones, with a strong focus on creating opportunities and closing new business.
   

  

 In this role, you will engage with senior business and technology leaders, identify transformation opportunities and bring together Sofigate’s Salesforce, AI and business transformation capabilities to create compelling solutions and measurable business value for our customers.
   

  

 We expect you to have experience from the Salesforce ecosystem and a strong understanding of complex B2B technology or consulting sales.
   

  

**What We Expect From You**
* Proven deal maker: You have a strong track record of winning new business and closing complex B2B technology or consulting deals. You enjoy prospecting, opening new doors and turning opportunities into revenue.
* Collaborative seller: You know how to bring the right experts, consultants and partners into the sales process and turn their expertise into a winning customer proposition.
* Business-driven customer engagement: You can engage senior business and technology leaders, understand their strategic priorities and translate them into compelling Salesforce transformation opportunities.
* Versatile background: Your diverse sales experience, combined with a background in growth-oriented companies, makes you adaptable and innovative.
* Executive relationship builder: You have a strong network in the Swedish market and the credibility to engage C-level decision-makers, build new relationships and create business opportunities.
* Senior sales professional: You bring extensive experience in complex B2B technology, consulting or transformation sales and know how to manage the full sales cycle from first contact to signed deal.
* Salesforce market understanding: You have experience selling Salesforce, CRM, cloud platforms or related transformation services and understand how technology, consulting services and partner ecosystems come together in complex customer solutions.
* You speak Swedish and also AI fluently. Agentforce and Data360 are not just techy talk as you can not only explain but also frame their value and some use cases to a customer. Leveraging AI and agents in your own work comes naturally.


 We know our list of requirements is long but in the end we’re after the right mix. We’re looking for talent and potential. Dare and get in touch with us.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build and grow a strong Salesforce sales pipeline in Sweden, with a clear focus on new business.
* Identify and open new strategic customer relationships and turn them into concrete sales opportunities.
* Own the sales cycle from prospecting and opportunity qualification to proposal, negotiation and closing.
* Grow selected existing accounts and identify new Salesforce transformation opportunities within them.
* Build trusted relationships with C-level business and technology decision-makers.
* Work closely with Salesforce, Sofigate consultants, solution experts and delivery teams to create winning propositions.
* Lead complex sales processes, including RFI/RFP processes, commercial negotiations and value propositions.
* Contribute market and customer insight to the development of Sofigate's Salesforce offering in Sweden.


**What’s in it for you?**
 Want to work with world-class technologies, best-in-class business technology management practices and a team of experts? You’re in the right place with us.
   

  

 As a Sofigator, you get the opportunity to work with knowledgeable and driven colleagues, develop and challenge yourself and create sustainable value for our customers. We have an international, vibrant and fun culture with great openness and flexibility. We value every Sofigator and strive to build a diverse, equal, and inclusive workplace where everyone’s voice is heard, and where everyone can become the best versions of themselves. We value a healthy work life balance and support you in maintaining it.
   

  

 Growth is not just a corporate thing for us – it is personal. There is so much to explore and learn within our community, and together with our customers, that having a bit of fun is unavoidable.
   

  

**We would like to hear from you**
 Tell us your story and let us know why you are the change maker we are looking for.
   

  

 If you have any questions, please contact:
   

  

 Mikael Ekman, Country Manager Sweden, at mikael.ekman@sofigate.com
   

  

**About Sofigate**
 We are The Business Technology Company with the fastest time-to-value in the gen AI era. We achieve that by combining our transformation expertise with low/no-code platforms and generative AI. That’s how we create sustainable customer value.
   

  

 In practice, that means helping our customers develop the interplay between business and technology: to design, build, and implement transformations and business-friendly technology solutions.
   

  

 We are more than 800 top notch professionals with diverse backgrounds, working with customers from all sectors and various industries. We are a people business, and we believe it’s our people’s competence that counts.
   

  

 We want you to add your skills into the mix. At Sofigate, you will find plenty of collective know-how to draw on, along with opportunities to learn and grow
   

  

 Our values Dare, Care and Grow are visible in our every day life - find out more about Sofigate and join us!

title: IAM Ansvarig
description:
Var med och bygg upp ett av SBAB:s viktigaste säkerhetsområden
   

  

 Vill du vara med och bygga upp en central funktion som stärker säkerheten, minskar risker och säkerställer att rätt personer har rätt behörigheter vid rätt tillfälle?
   

  

 På SBAB satsar vi nu på att utveckla vår Identity & Access Management-förmåga (IAM). Området är en av våra högst prioriterade säkerhetssatsningar och vi söker nu en IAM Ansvarig som vill ta en ledande roll i att etablera, utveckla och driva arbetet framåt.
   

  

 Det här är en unik möjlighet för dig som vill kombinera strategi, styrning och operativt genomförande i en verksamhet där säkerhet, regulatoriska krav och användarupplevelse går hand i hand.
   

  

 Om rollen
   

  

 Som IAM Ansvarig får du ett helhetsansvar för att utveckla och stärka SBAB:s arbete inom identitets- och behörighetshantering. Du kommer att verka tvärfunktionellt mellan verksamhet, IT, säkerhet och utvecklingsteam och vara en nyckelperson i arbetet med att skapa en modern, effektiv och centraliserad IAM-förmåga.
   

  

 Rollen innebär både strategiskt och operativt ansvar, där du leder utvecklingen av processer, styrning och arbetssätt samtidigt som du driver konkreta initiativ och förbättringar. Rollen ligger på vår avdelning för Säkerhet och du rapporterar till Säkerhetschef.
   

  

 Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden
   

  

* Utforma och vidareutveckla SBAB:s strategi, styrning och processer inom IAM.
* Stödja systemägare, projektledare och chefer i utformning och förvaltning av behörigheter utifrån principen om minsta privilegium.
* Säkerställa att IAM-krav integreras i utvecklingsinitiativ, projekt och systemförändringar.
* Initiera, samordna och följa upp regelbundna behörighetsrevisioner för system, roller och användare.
* Samarbeta med interna och externa intressenter för att säkerställa efterlevnad av regulatoriska krav såsom DORA, GDPR och banksekretess.
* Identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och driva initiativ som stärker säkerhet, effektivitet och användarupplevelse.


 Vem är du?
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av att arbeta med IAM, behörighetshantering och som trivs i en roll där du får skapa struktur, bygga relationer och driva förändring.
   

  

 För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du:
   

  

* Har erfarenhet av Identity & Access Management och behörighetsstyrning.
* Har förståelse för informationssäkerhet, riskhantering och regulatoriska krav.
* Har erfarenhet av att arbeta nära både verksamhet och tekniska team.
* Är van att driva förändringsinitiativ och skapa engagemang hos olika intressenter.
* Har god analytisk förmåga och kan omsätta komplexa krav till tydliga processer och arbetssätt.
* Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska.


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:
   

  

* Omada eller andra IAM-plattformar.
* Finansiell verksamhet eller annan reglerad bransch.
* Dora eller governance-frågor.
* Microsoft 365


 Därför ska du välja SBAB
   

  

 Vi tror på samarbete, nytänkande och att skapa verkligt värde genom smarta lösningar.
   

  

 I den här rollen får du:
   

  

* Möjlighet att bygga upp och påverka ett strategiskt viktigt område från grunden.
* Arbeta nära verksamhet, IT och säkerhetsfunktioner.
* En central roll i SBAB:s säkerhets- och digitaliseringsresa.
* Stor frihet att driva förbättringar och sätta riktning för framtidens IAM-förmåga.


 Välkommen till SBAB
   

  

 Om du vill vara med och skapa en modern, säker och effektiv identitets- och behörighetshantering som gör verklig skillnad för verksamheten, ser vi fram emot din ansökan.

title: System Specialist
description:
At Aceve, we back the builders of society. Founded in the Nordics and growing across Europe, we build digital tools for the people who construct and maintain our physical world - giving electricians, plumbers, and contractors back their time, clarity, and confidence. With over 900 employees across 8 countries, leading brands in 7 customer markets, and more than €100M in revenue, we're on an ambitious growth journey, and we're just getting started. We're an AI-first company, and we work with grit, openness, and a good dose of joy.
   

  

 When a customer hits a wall, you're the one who figures it out. As our System Specialist, you're the technical depth behind our Customer Support team — the person first line turn to when things get genuinely complex. You don't wait for someone to hand you a brief. You dig in, make the call, and make sure the same thing doesn't happen twice.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You sit at the intersection of our customers, our support team, and our engineering organisation. When something breaks — or just doesn't work the way it should — you're the one who takes it further. You diagnose, resolve, and document. You turn a customer's frustration into a fixed problem, and then you make sure the product team knows what caused it. What you do shapes directly how customers experience our software, and that matters.
   

  

**What Will You Do**
 You'll own the technical resolution layer of our support operation — working across channels and teams to make sure nothing slips through.
   

  

* Provide third-line and second -line technical support and general support to first line colleagues, and directly to customers via phone, email, chat, and remote sessions
* Diagnose and resolve technical issues related to software, hardware, and network configurations
* Log all customer interactions and technical issues accurately in our ticketing system
* Build and maintain a deep understanding of our products so you can give customers and colleagues reliable, accurate guidance
* Escalate complex issues to engineering teams with clear context and documentation — and follow them through
* Collect customer feedback and report recurring issues and feature requests to the product team
* Stay current with product updates and best practices in technical support


**We believe you have**
* Proven experience in a technical support, IT, or customer-facing technical role
* A background in IT systems, finance software, or a related technical domain — formal education or equivalent hands-on experience
* The ability to work through complex problems systematically, even when the path isn't immediately obvious
* Clear, confident communication in both Swedish and English — written and spoken
* A calm, organised approach when things get busy or priorities shift
* Genuine patience and empathy with customers — you know there's a real person behind every ticket
* You bring strong self-drive and curiosity — always pushing forward


**Not ticking every box?** 
 No worries! We value potential and drive, so apply anyway or connect with us- you might be just what we're looking for in our growing organisation! Join Aceve and take your expertise to the next level, together we are redefining what’s possible in craft and construction solutions!
   

  

*Aceve is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our selection process is conducted continuously and without discrimination, ensuring an equal opportunity for all candidates.*

title: Distribution Partner Account Manager – Nordics, Baltics & Eastern Europe
description:
Extreme Networks represents a tremendous career challenge and personal growth opportunity. We’re a company of strong market standing, with proven technological capability, differentiators and the growth mindset to overachieve goals.
   

  

 We also adamantly promote an internal culture that truly embraces diversity, inclusion and equality in the workplace. We’re proud to foster an environment where every Extreme employee can thrive because of their differences, not despite them.
   

  

 Extreme’s EMEA distribution team stands out as one that fosters success in all aspects, from over-achieving sales targets to providing a first-class team culture.
   

  

 We are recruiting for the role of Distribution Partner Account Manager (DPAM) responsible for our key Nordics, Baltics & Eastern Europe region. The DPAM is the ‘quarterback’ for the distributor (disti) relationship. Working closely with regional leaders plus other stakeholders, the DPAM ensures distributor activity aligns with the business priorities of the EMEA and global distribution team and to our Regional Directors’ (RD) objectives.
   

  

**The DPAM is fundamentally an experienced leader and influencer who…**
* Reports to the Senior Director, EMEA Distribution as part of a global distribution organization;
* Drives corporate sales revenue with deep focus on disti-led high potential resellers to ensure a pipeline of new and emerging VARs and MSPs;
* Maintains continuous sell-in focus to ensure disti inventory holding metrics are met;
* Aligns with stakeholders / business partners including iDPAM, regional RD, Channel Leaders, PAMs, Field Sales, Services/Support Team, SE teams, Disti Ops, Order Management Team, Finance, RevRec, Supply Chain and Legal team.


**The DPAM owns the C-Level relationship (and below) with all distributors in region and manages these core responsibilities:**
* Builds and executes a plan to maximize and measure disti performance, reflecting local plans where relevant
* Aligns to RD and Channel Leader to realize the reseller development potential of the region
* Manages a consistent set of KPIs
* Enables cloud capability into and through disti
* Leads contractual and other operational negotiations
* Leads inventory and stocking discussions to satisfy contractual / program minimums and other corporate objectives
* Manages the weekly bookings and POS forecast as well as stock rotation expectations
* Partners with distributor and Extreme channel marketing team to execute strategic marketing programs and activities
* Leads Quarterly Business Planning (QBP) with distributors and stakeholders
* Evaluates and enables disti partner program compliance, including competence
* Participates in setting quarterly Value Incentive Rebate (VIR) targets and attainment tracking
* Proactively manages MDF approvals and spend in alignment with the business and marketing plan
* Shares best practices and initiatives, covers colleague absences when appropriate and maintains continuity of business plan for own accounts with colleagues
* Leads a virtual team of iDPAM and other colleagues


**Necessary Skills Will Include**
* Degree level education and/or significant distribution management experience
* Relevant local language fluency as well as fluent English
* An optimistic, confident and enthusiastic attitude with a progressive and pragmatic approach to achieving goals
* Self-starter and team player
* An experienced background or strong solution selling skillset in transmitting advanced technology differentiators into the channel
* Able and willing to travel regularly across the region (some global travel) including some out-of-hours working
* Strong relationship-building, presentation, AI and problem-solving skills
* An influencer and leader


 OTE is on a 60/40 split and is based on qualifications and experience between 1.2 and 1.4 million SEK.
   

  

 Extreme Networks Benefits
   

  

 Fundamentally, the successful candidate will be someone who brings us something new, who embraces change, who is a great cultural fit, who leads virtual teams with passion and respect and who makes Extreme more relevant to our distributors whilst making our distributors more relevant to Extreme.
   

  

**Extreme Networks, Inc. (** 
**EXTR** 
**) creates effortless networking experiences that enable all of us to advance. We push the boundaries of technology leveraging the powers of machine learning, artificial intelligence, analytics, and automation. Over 50,000 customers globally trust our end-to-end, cloud-driven networking solutions and rely on our top-rated services and support to accelerate their digital transformation efforts and deliver progress like never before. For more information, visit Extreme's** 
**website** 
**or follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, and Facebook.**
 We encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. Come Advance with us! In keeping with our values, no employee or applicant will face discrimination/harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination/harassment based on “protected categories,” Extreme Networks also strives to prevent other, subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (e.g., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our organization. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at Extreme Networks.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Erfaren utvecklare till ESSIQ Stockholm
description:
Nu letar vi efter en erfaren Ada/Java-utvecklare till ESSIQ Stockholm! ESSIQ är arbetsgivaren som anstränger sig lite extra för att du ska må bra. Vad är medarbetarfokus för dig? På ESSIQ handlar det om att sätta medarbetaren i centrum. Genom ett lyhört ledarskap och en öppen företagskultur vill vi ge varje medarbetare möjligheten att forma sin karriär och sin vardag.
   

  

 Till den här rollen söker vi dig som har erfarenhet av Java och gärna även Ada, och som trivs med att arbeta med stora och komplexa system. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av Ada samt en bakgrund inom desktop- eller andra icke-webbaserade system. Du har ett starkt tekniskt intresse och trivs med att själv vara hands-on i utvecklingen och implementera lösningar.
   

  

**ROLLBESKRIVNING**
 Som utvecklare arbetar du med utveckling och vidareutveckling av större och komplexa tekniska system. Du kommer att arbeta nära tekniken och vara delaktig i att förstå, utveckla och implementera lösningar i system där krav på kvalitet, stabilitet och långsiktighet står i fokus.
   

  

 Rollen passar dig som har ett starkt tekniskt intresse och som trivs med att ta ansvar för att hitta lösningar på komplexa problem. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av att själv implementera lösningar och att du tidigare har haft ett större tekniskt ansvar i utvecklingsprojekt.
   

  

 Erfarenhet av Ada är meriterande, särskilt om du har arbetat med plattformen under en längre tid. Vi värdesätter praktisk erfarenhet och förståelse för Ada snarare än specifik erfarenhet av moderna ramverk. Erfarenhet av Java är också relevant för rollen.
   

  

 Du kommer att arbeta i miljöer där systemen är stora, komplexa och ofta inte webbaserade. Därför är det viktigt att du trivs med att förstå helheten, sätta dig in i befintlig kod och arkitektur samt identifiera och genomföra väl avvägda tekniska lösningar.
   

  

 En anställning hos oss innebär både trygghet och frihet, där vi stöttar dig så mycket som du vill och behöver. För oss är det viktigt att du får vara delaktig i att forma din karriärväg och att du är med och påverkar ESSIQ som företag och arbetsplats.
   

  

**KVALIFIKATIONER**
 Vi letar inte efter anställda, vi letar efter medarbetare – efter ESSIQ:are! Nedanstående är de grundläggande kvalifikationerna för tjänsten, men vi kommer även lägga stor vikt vid din personlighet.
   

  

**Grundläggande kvalifikationer**
* Civil- eller högskoleingenjör.
* Erfarenhet av utveckling i Java.
* Erfarenhet av utveckling i större och komplexa system.
* Erfarenhet av desktop- eller andra icke-webbaserade system.
* Erfarenhet av att självständigt implementera tekniska lösningar.
* Erfarenhet av Ada.


**Personlighet och engagemang**
* Du är ansvarstagande – kommer i mål, i medvind likväl som i motvind.
* Du är social och kommunikativ – öppen och tydlig gentemot dina kollegor, och är en produktiv problemlösare. Du är bra på att föra samtal om dig, arbetsteamet och leveransen inför en eller flera åhörare.
* Du är lyhörd och hjälpsam – tar in kunskap från omvärld och kollegor, och delar gärna med dig av din egen. Du är generös med tips, hjälp och stöd.


**OM TJÄNSTEN**
* Anställningsform: tillsvidareanställning på heltid. 6 månaders provanställning tillämpas.
* Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.
* Lön och förmåner: Konkurrenskraftig fast eller rörlig lön. Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och generösa förmåner. Tjänstepension, omfattande försäkringar.
* Placering: ESSIQ Stockholm.


**OM ESSIQ**
 ESSIQ är teknikkonsultföretaget där allt börjar med dig. Med fokus på individen, flexibla lösningar och en modern lönepolicy attraherar vi de skarpaste, mest professionella och engagerade personerna i branschen. Med denna vision grundades ESSIQ år 2005, sedan dess har vi utvecklats till ett framgångsrikt företag med kontor i Stockholm, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi består idag av över 250 medarbetare med olika bakgrund, personlighet och nationalitet, med en god fördelning av kvinnor och män.
   

  

 Vi har över 80 aktiva kunder i spännande branscher – allt från de stora aktörerna till de små innovationsföretagen. ESSIQ:s medarbetare arbetar med användarcentrerad tjänste- och produktutveckling inom följande tjänsteområden: UX & Service Design, Connected & Embedded Systems, IT & Cloud Services, Green Technology & Electromobility, Test & Quality Engineering, Agile Management, Mechanical Engineering samt Simulation & Visualization. Kompetensen levererar vi på plats hos uppdragsgivaren, inhouse och i satellit. Våra medarbetares intressen och ambitioner leder vägen – vårt mål är att göra den perfekta matchningen av individ och uppdrag.
   

  

 ESSIQ är ett familjärt och socialt företag med visionen att vara Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare för alla medarbetare, oavsett roll i organisationen. Vi lägger stor vikt vid gemenskap och har ett uppskattat utbud av professionella och sociala aktiviteter. Vår kommunikationsplattform genomsyras av öppenhet, och främjar nätverkande och kompetensutbyte såväl som fritidsaktiviteter och relationsbyggande.
   

  

**ANSÖKAN**
**Version Hemsida/LI:** 
 Vi använder oss av rekryteringsverktyget Teamtailor.
   

  

**KONTAKT**
 Frågor om tjänsten? Kontakta: Malin Meyer, malin.meyer@essiq.se
   

  

 Vill du veta mer om ESSIQ?
   

  

 Besök http://essiq.se och följ oss på våra sociala medier!

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Role: AI Developer
 



 Location: Stockholm, Sweden
 



 Work Mode: Hybrid Mode (2days on-site required per week)
 



 Hiring Type: Freelance / B2B Contract
 



 Duration: 6months
 



 Start Date: ASAP
 



  





 Technical Competency Needed:
 


* Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Python and AI/ML application development

title: IT-Support på Finska
description:
Vi söker fler kollegor till vår Servicedesk i Stockholm
   

  

 Nu söker vi nya medarbetare till vår
 **Servicedesk i Stockholm.** 
 Oavsett om du är i början av din IT-karriär, vill ta steget in i branschen eller redan har erfarenhet av support vill vi gärna komma i kontakt med dig. För den här rollen behöver du
 **tala finska flytande.**
 Vi uppskattar olika erfarenheter, perspektiv och bakgrunder. Det är en viktig del av hur vi bygger starka team som trivs, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Då är det kanske dig vi söker och vi ser fram emot att berätta mer om möjligheterna hos oss! 💜
   

  

 Rollen som IT-supporttekniker
   

  

 Som IT-supporttekniker i Advanias Servicedesk hjälper du användare i våra kunders IT-miljöer. Du tar emot ärenden via telefon och e-post, felsöker, guidar användare och följer upp tills problemet är löst.
   

  

 Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i olika IT-miljöer och utvecklas i takt med att din erfarenhet växer. Du blir en del av ett team som delar kunskap, stöttar varandra och vill se dig lyckas.
   

  

 Inom vår servicedesk arbetar vi utan en tydlig uppdelning mellan första och andra linjen. Vi hjälps åt att lösa så många ärenden som möjligt nära användaren, vilket ger dig bred erfarenhet och stora möjligheter att utvecklas.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att arbeta i miljöer som Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Intune och andra vanliga plattformar inom modern IT-support.
   

  

 Rollen är placerad i Stockholm och du utgår från vårt kontor i Liljeholmen.
   

  

 Exempel på arbetsuppgifter
   

  

  

* Ta emot ärenden från användare och ge ett professionellt och tryggt bemötande.
* Felsöka och lösa problem i användarnas IT-miljö.
* Hjälpa användare med klienter, mobila enheter, konton och behörigheter.
* Administrera användare och grupper i Active Directory.
* Följa upp och slutföra ärenden med fokus på kvalitet och kundnöjdhet.
* Identifiera återkommande problem och bidra till förbättringar i supportleveransen.


 Så lyckas du i rollen hos oss
   

  

 I servicedeskrollen är du ofta kundens första kontakt med Advania. Det viktigaste för oss är inte att du kan allt från dag ett, viljan att utvecklas och jobba tillsammans betyder mer. Vi tror att du kommer trivas och lyckas om du tycker om att hjälpa människor, är nyfiken på teknik och gillar att lösa problem tillsammans med andra.
   

  

 Hos oss får du stöd att utveckla sådant som gör skillnad i kundmötet, till exempel att:
   

  

  

* Skapa förtroende genom ett lugnt, tydligt och hjälpsamt bemötande.
* Förstå vad användaren faktiskt behöver och ställa rätt frågor.
* Förklara lösningar så att mottagaren hänger med, oavsett teknisk nivå.
* Ta initiativ och driva ärendet framåt även när det är många saker på gång.
* Be om hjälp i tid, samarbeta och dela kunskap så att teamet lyckas tillsammans.


 Det här är färdigheter som ofta förknippas med konsultmässighet och självledarskap. Om du inte känner igen dig i de begreppen än är det helt okej. Vi hjälper dig att växa in i rollen och utveckla de förmågor som gör skillnad för våra kunder.
   

  

 Vad du har med dig ✨
   

  

 För att trivas i rollen är du serviceinriktad, noggrann och gillar att samarbeta. Du uppskattar en miljö där vi delar kunskap med varandra och där du får möjlighet att utvecklas över tid.
   

  

 För att kunna göra ett riktigt bra jobb i rollen behöver du:
   

  

  

* Behärska svenska, finska och engelska i tal och skrift.
* Kunna kommunicera tydligt och professionellt, även när tempot är högt eller problemet är komplext.


 Har du dessutom något av det här med dig ser vi det som ett extra plus:
   

  

  

* Erfarenhet av IT-support, servicedesk eller teknisk support.
* Erfarenhet från serviceyrken där bemötande och problemlösning varit en viktig del av arbetet.
* Kunskap inom exempelvis Windows Server och klient, macOS, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Endpoint Manager, nätverk, hårdvara och ärendehanteringssystem, gärna ServiceNow.
* Vana att felsöka och lösa problem med ett logiskt arbetssätt.
* Gymnasial examen eller motsvarande utbildning.


 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! 👋
   

  

 Visa gärna ditt intresse så snart som möjligt då vi intervjuar löpande. Vi välkomnar sökanden med olika bakgrunder, erfarenheter och synsätt, eftersom vi vet att en bredare mångfald berikar var och en av oss och stärker såväl effektivitet som kreativitet i vårt arbete.
   

  

 Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomgår våra slutkandidater en obligatorisk bakgrundskontroll, en för oss kvalitativ kontroll inför ett anställningsbeslut. Advania samarbetar med Ljung & Sjöberg i ärenden kopplat till alkohol-, drog- och spelproblematik och är en certifierad "Proaktiv Arbetsplats".
   

  

 Tveka inte att höra av dig om du har några frågor eller funderingar.☀️
   

  

 Det är du som arbetar nära kunden som vet vad dem behöver och vad som blir den bästa lösningen för just deras unika behov, både i dag och i morgon. Därför tycker vi att det är du som ska fatta besluten. Det är genom att erbjuda säkra, hållbara och kundanpassade lösningar som vi skapar värde för kunderna och samhället i stort.
   

  

 Vi bryr oss om hur våra medarbetare mår – på riktigt. Därför samarbetar Advania med Ljung & Sjöberg för att skapa en trygg, proaktiv arbetsmiljö med stöd kring alkohol-, drog- och beroenderelaterade frågor. Tillsammans bygger vi en hållbar arbetsplats där det är okej att be om hjälp, och där förebyggande arbete gör skillnad – för individen, teamet och företaget.
   

  

 I en miljö präglad av stort kundfokus och frihet under ansvar blir det extra viktigt för oss att bygga starka team bestående av ödmjuka stjärnor. Att arbeta i en inkluderande miljö, med kollegor och kunder som vill utvecklas, ger oss möjligheten att trivas och ha riktigt roligt på jobbet. Vi tror på en platt organisation med agilt arbetssätt och flexibilitet. Detta är det enda sättet för en hållbar framtid.
   

  

 Advania Sverige, ”The tech company with people at heart”, har kontor över hela landet, från Luleå i norr till Malmö i syd. Dagligen hjälper våra 1 700 specialister våra kunder, både inom privat och offentlig sektor, i deras ambitioner och mål att digitalisera sina verksamheter. Genom långsiktiga relationer, ledande teknologier, moderna plattformslösningar och strategiska partnerskap formar vi framtidens IT-landskap. Vårt syfte sträcker sig bortom teknik: att ge människor kraften att skapa hållbara värden.
   

  

 Advaniagruppen levererar tjänster till kunder i Sverige, Norge, Storbritannien, Island, Finland och Danmark inom hållbar och säker digitalisering.

title: Cloud IT Engineer
description:
**About Justera Group**

The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise in enterprise-scale cloud architecture with strong leadership capabilities in incident management and stakeholder engagement.

 : Warsaw

 3 days a week at the office.

**Requirements:**

* Expert-level proficiency in Terraform for infrastructure as code
* Advanced skills in Ansible for configuration management and automation
* Strong programming capabilities in Python and Bash scripting
* Extensive experience with CI/CD tools including Jenkins and GitHub Actions
* Deep understanding of cloud networking concepts and hybrid connectivity solutions


 It would be ideal if you also have:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
* Professional cloud certifications (GCP Professional Cloud Architect)

* Knowledge of security frameworks and compliance standards
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack)

* Experience in agile development methodologies


**What We Offer:**
* A dynamic and innovative workplace driving advancements in cutting-edge robotic technologies
* The opportunity to collaborate with talented cross-functional teams on meaningful and impactful projects
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package
* A supportive culture that fosters continuous learning, growth, and professional development
* Flexible hybrid working model for an optimal work-life balance
* 25 days of annual leave to recharge and relax
* An annual wellness allowance of 3,500 SEK to support your health and wellbeing

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About Froda**
 Founded in 2015, Froda’s mission is to democratize access to financing, giving small businesses the same growth opportunities as large ones. Through digital innovation, we’ve transformed the loan process from months to minutes, offering fair, fast, and accessible financing. Now, through embedded lending, we’re integrating our technology with global banks and fintechs, building the next generation of lending infrastructure. Join us in creating opportunities for small businesses to invest in their ideas to the best possible terms.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an Engineering Manager at Froda, you will lead 2–3 cross-functional product teams and ensure we deliver value clearly, predictably, and with high quality. Working closely with Product Managers and Tech Leads, you will create focus, remove obstacles, and build strong teams that can move fast while maintaining a healthy and reliable platform, working iteratively to ship, learn, and continuously improve our products and systems.
   

  

 Through close collaboration with your teams, you will help shape the technical direction of the areas you lead, connecting business needs with sustainable engineering decisions and ensuring we continuously improve how we build, ship, and learn from what we deliver.
   

  

**In this role, you will:**
* Drive delivery across multiple teams by improving how teams plan, execute, and follow up on their work, ensuring priorities and commitments are realistic and aligned with business goals while supporting iterative delivery and continuous learning
* Identify and manage risks, dependencies, and capacity challenges early
* Support a healthy balance between product delivery and technical improvements
* Coach and develop engineers while fostering a sustainable and high-performing team environment
* Build strong cross-functional relationships across Product, Tech, Commercial, and Partnerships


**This role offers the opportunity to have a real impact on how teams collaborate, deliver, and evolve our platform at a fintech company with strong momentum and a stable foundation, backed by a banking license as a quality stamp.**
**Who are you?**
 We believe you are an engineering leader who thrives in dynamic, fast-moving environments. You enjoy creating clarity in complexity and building teams that deliver value continuously while improving how they work.
   

  

 You are confident in stakeholder dialogue, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and proactive in driving improvements rather than waiting for direction. You lead with calmness, ownership, and a strong sense of accountability.
   

  

 You are fluent in English, Swedish is a plus.
   

  

**We believe you have experience with:**
* Leading engineering teams in a product-focused tech organization
* Driving delivery, planning, and execution across teams with a focus on predictability and quality
* A solid technical background that allows you to understand architectural trade-offs and engineering challenges
* Coaching and developing engineers through continuous feedback and performance follow-up
* Working closely with Product Managers and Tech Leads to balance scope, risk, and long-term improvements
* Improving development processes, ways of working, and engineering practices
* Navigating cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management


**What’s in it for you?**
 At Froda, you’ll be part of a company that combines the best of both worlds – a fast-moving, high-energy culture with the stability and structure to support long-term success. We’re 100+ ambitious self-starters who genuinely care for each other and the work we do, all while having fun together.
   

  

 Here, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how we execute and scale engineering, influence both delivery and long-term platform evolution, and build high-performing teams with real ownership. With big ambitions and a rapidly evolving business, there’s plenty of room to grow, take initiative, and make a lasting impact on both our company and the industry.
   

  

**Furthermore, you’ll get:**
* An opportunity to play a key role in scaling a fintech platform that powers funding for thousands of entrepreneurs
* A central leadership position in our tech organization, with real influence on how we work and deliver
* Fabulous office overlooking Stockholm
* We prioritize working in the office to maximize the positive impact of in-person collaboration, but we offer flexibility with work hours and remote work
* Competitive compensation package
* Insurance and pension plan


**This role is all about building the teams and execution that power funding for thousands of entrepreneurs, if you're excited by our mission, apply or tell a friend!**

title: Mid-Market Account Executive, Nordics

 We're looking for an Account Executive to drive Lovable's next chapter of growth across the Nordics, bringing our AI-powered software creation platform to companies from fast-moving mid-market players to the region's largest enterprises.  Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. description:
**Garantum är en privatägd koncern verksam inom förmögenhetsförvaltning för privatpersoner, företag och institutioner. Vi strävar efter långsiktiga och nära kundrelationer som bygger på ömsesidigt förtroende. På så sätt kan vi erbjuda individanpassad rådgivning av hög kvalitet nära våra kunder. Idag har Garantum över 190 anställda i koncernen och 140 anknutna rådgivare runt om i Sverige och Norge.**
**Om tjänsten**
 Vi erbjuder en varierad roll inom IT där du arbetar nära verksamheten och våra användare. Du blir en del av en organisation där IT har en central roll i den dagliga verksamheten och du får möjlighet att utvecklas inom både support och systemadministration.
   

  

 I tjänsten arbetar du med användarsupport, felsökning samt administration och underhåll av vår IT-miljö. Rollen är bred och har många kontaktytor och ger dig möjlighet att bidra till en stabil och välfungerande IT-miljö.
   

  

**Dina arbetsuppgifter**
 I rollen hjälper du våra användare att få en så smidig IT-vardag som möjligt. Med ett serviceinriktat och lösningsorienterat arbetssätt ger du support och vägledning och bidrar till att medarbetarna kan använda våra IT-system och digitala verktyg på ett effektivt sätt.
   

  

 Arbetet omfattar även underhåll, administration och utveckling av våra IT-system. Du har många kontaktytor och samarbetar nära med medarbetare, konsulter och externa systemleverantörer.
   

  

 För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara serviceinriktad och kommunikativ samt tycka om att hjälpa andra. Du tar eget ansvar, kan prioritera mellan olika arbetsuppgifter och samarbetar gärna med andra för att hitta välfungerande lösningar.
   

  

**Vem är du**
 Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av Microsofts produkter och tjänster och som är van vid att arbeta med felsökning och problemlösning. Du motiveras av att ge professionell support och service och av att underlätta användarnas dagliga IT-arbete.
   

  

 Du är flexibel, trivs med varierande arbetsuppgifter och tar ansvar för att lösa problem, både självständigt och tillsammans med andra. Du är nyfiken, har lätt för att sätta dig in i nya system och arbetssätt och vill kontinuerligt utveckla dina kunskaper. Vi ser också gärna att du har ett intresse för vår verksamhet och en vilja att lära dig mer.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
* Goda kunskaper i Microsoft produkter och tjänster
* Goda kunskaper i Microsoft Windows Server och Microsoft SQL Server
* Förmåga att övervaka system och infrastruktur samt bidra till en stabil drift
* Förmåga att självständigt felsöka och lösa användarrelaterade IT-problem
* Kunskaper om säkerhetskopiering, behörighetsstyrning och IT-säkerhet
* Kunskaper om certifikathantering och nätverkslösningar
* Kunskaper om molntjänster och virtualisering
* Erfarenhet av att felsöka datorer, bildskärmar, skrivare och konferensrumsteknik
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift
* God social och kommunikativ förmåga samt ett positivt och serviceinriktat bemötande
* Förmåga att förstå och anpassa stödet efter olika användares behov

title: Service & Commissioning Engineer
description:
Vill du arbeta nära den senaste tekniken, lösa komplexa utmaningar och vara den person som kunder litar på när avancerade testsystem ska fungera på topp? Då kan du vara den Service Engineer vi söker.
  
  

Hos AVL List Nordiska arbetar vi i framkant inom Instrumentation & Test Systems på den nordiska marknaden. Vi är ett team på 30 personer i Göteborg och Stockholm – och nu behöver vi en Service Engineer till vårt team i Göteborg.
  
  

Hos oss får du en roll där du kombinerar teknik, problemlösning och kundkontakt, samtidigt som du får stora möjligheter att utvecklas i en internationell miljö.
  
  

**DINA ANSVARSOMRÅDEN:**  

Som Service Engineer ansvarar du för att säkerställa att våra kunders emissionsmätsystem och instrument fungerar med högsta möjliga tillförlitlighet och prestanda. Du arbetar nära våra kunder och blir en viktig teknisk partner som bidrar med både service, support och specialistkunskap. Rollen innebär stor variation där du växlar mellan planerade serviceinsatser, felsökning, teknisk rådgivning och utvecklande kunduppdrag.
  
  

I det dagliga arbetet utför du service, underhåll, kalibrering och driftsättning av emissionsmätningsinstrument samt säkerställer att utrustningen uppfyller gällande kvalitets- och säkerhetskrav. Du stödjer även kunderna inom mätning och analys av avgasreningssystem och hjälper dem att optimera sina processer och tekniska lösningar. Genom att analysera problem, identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och föreslå lösningar bidrar du till att skapa långsiktigt värde för kunden.
  
  

Du arbetar både självständigt och tillsammans med kollegor i teambaserade uppdrag där samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och ett lösningsorienterat arbetssätt är avgörande för framgång. Dokumentation, rapportering och uppföljning är en naturlig del av rollen, liksom ett kontinuerligt arbete med att utveckla och förbättra våra arbetssätt, processer och tjänster.
  
  

Tjänsten innebär resor till kunder i Sverige och, i vissa fall, internationellt. Det ger dig möjlighet att arbeta i varierande miljöer, lära känna olika verksamheter och utvecklas inom avancerad mätteknik och ny teknologi.
  
  

**DIN PROFIL:**  

**För att trivas och lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:**  

Minst 2 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom service, underhåll, mätteknik, teknisk support eller liknande område.
  
God teknisk förståelse och erfarenhet av felsökning och problemlösning.
  
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med teknisk utrustning, instrument eller mätsystem.
  
God datorvana och erfarenhet av att arbeta i olika IT- och affärssystem.
  
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
  
B-körkort.
  
  

**Meriterande:**  

Erfarenhet av installation, driftsättning (commissioning), service och underhåll av mätutrustning, testsystem, precisionsutrustning eller liknande tekniska produkter.
  
Erfarenhet av lagkrav, regelverk och certifieringsprocesser kopplade till avgasreningssystem (Exhaust Aftertreatment Systems).
  
Erfarenhet av fältservice och arbete i kundnära tekniska miljöer.
  
Kunskap om och erfarenhet av emissionsmätningssystem och relaterad utrustning.
  
Erfarenhet av arbete inom fordonsindustrin, motorutveckling eller närliggande tekniska områden.
  
Erfarenhet av att arbeta i internationella projekt eller kundmiljöer.
  
  

**Som person:**  

Du är en serviceinriktad och engagerad person som trivs i en roll med stort eget ansvar och många kontaktytor. Du arbetar strukturerat och självständigt, samtidigt som du är flexibel och har lätt för att anpassa dig till förändrade förutsättningar och prioriteringar. Med ett lösningsorienterat och analytiskt förhållningssätt tar du dig an tekniska utmaningar på ett metodiskt sätt och drivs av att hitta effektiva lösningar för både kunder och verksamhet. Samtidigt är du en prestigelös lagspelare som uppskattar samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och att bidra till teamets gemensamma framgång.
  
  

**VI ERBJUDER:**  

På AVL blir du en del av ett globalt teknikföretag som ligger i framkant av utveckling, simulering och testning inom mobilitetens framtid. Som världens största oberoende aktör inom området, med över 12 000 medarbetare internationellt, driver vi innovation för en grönare, säkrare och bättre värld av mobilitet.
  
  

Vårt fokus sträcker sig över hela värdekedjan – från tidiga idé- och konceptfaser till industrialisering och serieproduktion. Vi arbetar med avancerad teknik inom elektrifiering, mjukvara, autonom körning, digitalisering och energieffektiva drivlinor, och hjälper våra kunder att forma framtidens mobilitetslösningar.
  
  

Hos oss får du en arbetsplats där du kan växa, påverka och vara med och driva teknikutvecklingen framåt – som gör verklig skillnad för framtidens mobilitet!
  
  

Intresserad?
  
  

I denna rekryteringsprocess tillämpar vi löpande urval. Det innebär att rekryteringsprocessen kan gå snabbt och att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.
  
  

Vi ser fram emot att ta emot din ansökan!
